TO: Stephen Colbert
FROM: Peter Willis
RE: Thank you for standing up to Trump
Dear Stephen Colbert,
Thank you so much for using your voice – and your platform – to stand up to Donald Trump and defend American democracy.
Even after your show was canceled, you’ve continued to speak out against Trump’s lies, cruelty, and authoritarian ambitions.
That kind of courage is rare – and deeply needed.
You’ve made us laugh, but you’ve also made us think. You’ve reminded us that satire has a place in the fight for truth, accountability, and justice.
So I’m signing this letter to say: Thank you. We see you. We stand with you. And I’m chipping in $7 to Democracy on the Line so we can elect more Democrats, fight back against MAGA extremism, and ensure voices like yours are never silenced again. » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mc_dotl_q32025_ltr_colbert?amount=7]

X Peter Willis

You and I sure as hell did not make the cut |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112452407/560532881/-140265690?refcode=WUEFE764_20250730_GOPPriorities_PL_v1s1&sourceid=1056668&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjNlMTg0Yy1hMTZkLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dXADVu97njrd2Ie56T735lRO1X0W3qV91t7h1utVyRY=) Peter,

Whether they mean to be or not, Republicans are showing their hand when it comes to their REAL priorities. Here's some of what makes the cut, where the GOP is concerned:
1. Taking health care away from 16 million Americans
2. Cutting taxes for the rich
3. Defunding Planned Parenthood
4. Undercutting Social Security

Did you catch that, Peter? Here's the first thing to notice:**You and I sure as hell aren't on that list.** They're not lowering costs. They're not helping our families.

Republicans are writing laws that actively harm Americans.

**Republicans are making life harder — and in some cases, deadly — for millions and millions of people, including their own constituents.** If your bank account doesn't have nine zeroes at the end of it, you can pretty much rest assured the Republican Party of 2025 is not looking out for your best interests.

At EMILYs List, our priorities look a little different. The women we endorse are fighting for all of us. They're pro-choice and pro-freedom. **Our work is powered BY the people, not power OVER people.** ****[**If you're with us in the fight to take back power and stop the Republicans' dangerous agenda in its tracks, please donate to support EMILYs List today.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112452410/560532884/-140265690?refcode=WUEFE764_20250730_GOPPriorities_PL_v1s1&sourceid=1056668&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjNlMTg0Yy1hMTZkLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dXADVu97njrd2Ie56T735lRO1X0W3qV91t7h1utVyRY=)**** | [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112452416/560532968/-140265690?refcode=WUEFE764_20250730_GOPPriorities_PL_v1s1&sourceid=1056668&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjNlMTg0Yy1hMTZkLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dXADVu97njrd2Ie56T735lRO1X0W3qV91t7h1utVyRY=)

It’s a warning sign for every city, suburb, and small town across our state. The far-left is on the march — and the DFL is rolling out the red carpet for them. | **Dear Friend,**
My faith has always been my compass, shaping my leadership and driving me to stand boldly for what’s right. In Washington, I’ve fought tirelessly to protect our freedoms, strengthen our communities, and uphold the moral foundation that makes America exceptional.

[**This mission is why I’m deeply honored to have the endorsement of President Donald Trump, a leader who shares our dedication to defending the values that unite us.**](https://markharrisforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=82117f51bb8b79bb18d514427&id=454bb24cc7&e=4024c5123e) His support is more than an endorsement—it’s a clarion call for us to come together at this pivotal moment to ensure our voices are heard and our beliefs shape the future of our nation. The 2026 midterms are not just another election; they are a defining opportunity to safeguard the principles we hold dear. From preserving religious liberty to defending the sanctity of life and securing a prosperous future for our children, the stakes could not be higher.
---

Your contribution will help us run a strong, grassroots campaign. Connecting with communities across North Carolina, sharing our vision, and mobilizing voters to make a difference on Election Day.
---

| _Thank you for standing with us._

Sincerely,

Mark Harris

subject: Breaking: Kamala Harris just announced that she is NOT running for governor of California.
body:
No BS, this announcement shifts the dynamics of our race.
Breaking news in our race:
**Kamala Harris just announced that she is NOT running for governor of California.**
**That means we’re the clear frontrunner among Democrats in this race. But I need your help to win. This is one of the most important days of this race and everyone will be looking to see how much we raise today. Can you split a donation of $5 or whatever makes sense for you between my campaign today and Deb Haaland?**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250730_1_ms-kp-em-haaland?amount=5&refcode=em20250730-3503&refcode2=3503_400544_WsAypl&akid=3503%2E400544%2EWsAypl)**
I worked with Kamala in the aftermath of the foreclosure crisis to keep Californians in their homes. I’m grateful for her dedicated years of service to our state, and I’m sure she will continue to make a difference in whatever she does next.
No BS, this announcement shifts the dynamics of our race, and the stakes just got a whole lot higher. This campaign has got what it takes to win, but we’re going to need the support of every single Porter Supporter reading this email.
**Recent polling shows our campaign just 1 point behind right-wing Fox News host Steve Hilton.** This race is within reach—if grassroots supporters like you step up right now to give us the momentum we need in this key moment of the race.
[**Can you rush a split $5 donation to our campaign and Deb Haaland today to help elect me as California’s next Governor and build a better future for California?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250730_1_ms-kp-em-haaland?amount=5&refcode=em20250730-3503&refcode2=3503_400544_WsAypl&akid=3503%2E400544%2EWsAypl)

Katie Porter

This article may upset some of my readers on the left, but I ask you to read all the way through first. And remember, as a human rights lawyer my standard is not political convenience, but absolute justice. That's why I must speak truth to power no matter what.
In America today, Islamophobia isn't just a Republican disease--it's a bipartisan epidemic. It's grotesque in all its forms, no matter which party peddles it. And if we are serious about justice, we must be serious about calling out both the open bigotry and the insidious hypocrisy--regardless of whether it comes with a red tie or a blue pin. **Let 's Address This.**

Governor Josh Shapiro (L) and Congressman Randy Fine (R)
## A Tale of Two Complicities
Let's take two examples: MAGA Republican Congressman Randy Fine and Pennsylvania's Democratic Governor Josh Shapiro. Two men. Two political parties. But both pushing the same dehumanizing narrative about Muslims--one with overt hate speech, the other with polished PR and silent complicity.
## **Randy Fine 's Islamophobia Isn't Subtle--It's Brutal**
Congressman Randy Fine has made it his brand to mock and vilify Muslims. When ABC News reported that 15 Palestinians had died of starvation in a single day in Gaza, Fine's response was to _wish for more death_ and claim it was all a hoax. "Release the hostages. Until then, starve away," he wrote on X. He added: "It amazes me that the media continues to regurgitate Muslim terror propaganda." That same day, Fine was appointed to the House Foreign Affairs Committee.
It didn't stop there. He bragged about the "Thump Thump Act," legislation designed to legalize running over protesters--including "Muslim terrorists," BLM activists, immigrants, and more. He tweeted gleefully about it: "Thump thump!"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b915017d-6e3a-4d1f-b539-e7e3feb5dbeb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This isn't fringe behavior. It's fascism in a suit. And it's being rewarded. But here's the thing. I believe Republicans when they tell us that they have capitulated to a fascist in the White House--and I know not to trust them. I recognize that Republicans have given up on being a legitimate political party, and are instead falling over each other to appease their dear leader and fascist-in-chief. I will continue to document, condemn, and oppose their extremist, anti-Constitutional, anti-democracy, and anti-justice views and platforms.
And, I will also hold accountable Democratic politicians who claim to stand for justice, democracy, and the Constitution, but then betray that promise. Hence, consider the case of Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dDiONKgq3Sxh_ZAfkl0LqDuVSSm6XsCSNWexuEuIF8A?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=169696116)
## **Shapiro 's Silence--and Hypocrisy--is Just as Dangerous**
You might think the Democratic Governor of Pennsylvania Josh Shapiro would speak out against this kind of hate. Instead, he's piling on and targeting Democratic nominee for NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani, openly smearing him as antisemitic. Why? Because Mamdani hasn't, according to Shapiro, condemned antisemitism _enough._
Never mind that Mamdani has loudly committed as part of his mayoral platform to increase funding by 800% to fight antisemitism. Never mind that he's endorsed by Jewish leaders like NYC Comptroller Brad Lander and Congressman Jerry Nadler, who represents the largest Jewish population in the U.S. and who are vouching for Mamdani's sincerity. Never mind that Mamdani is on record about the need to comprehensively tackle and counter antisemitism in New York City and throughout the country.
For Shapiro, facts don't seem to matter in this case.
And here's where the hypocrisy becomes impossible to ignore: This week Shapiro went on _Ted Nugent 's_ podcast to praise the man as someone he deeply admires and feels welcomed by.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/354ae383-cd5c-466b-9003-ed376768d787?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yes, _that_ Ted Nugent--who is an ardent Trump ally. That Ted Nugent, who has pushed white supremacist and racist rhetoric for decades. That Ted Nugent, who has an SPLC-documented hate profile specifically for extensive, decades long history, of antisemitic rhetoric and demonization of Jewish people.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0a7d6437-f195-4a74-95e4-df1cded09923?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Nugent has called Michael Bloomberg, then NYC mayor, the mayor of "Jew York City." He has claimed "Jews" were trying to take Americans' guns. And thus the further irony of Shapiro joining Nugent's podcast to accept praise for _expanding_ firearm access in Pennsylvania. And while Shapiro wants Mamdani to further condemn antisemitism, Nugent has never apologized for his decades of antisemitism. But that didn't stop Shapiro from joining his podcast and praising Nugent anyway as someone he respects and feels welcomed by. Do we not see the double standard here?
It is probably unsurprising that Governor Josh Shapiro's anti-Palestinian racism is well documented. [He previously has stated, and never apologized for](https://substack.com/redirect/06cfeb4d-c63e-44f8-96ec-d6c8318bbf4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) claiming:
> "Palestinians will not coexist peacefully. They do not have the capabilities to establish their own homeland and make it successful even with the aid of Israel and the US. They are too battle-minded to be able to establish a peaceful homeland of their own....The only way a 'peace plan' will be successful is if the Palestinians do not ruin it."

Is this what we should expect from Democratic politicians?

## **So What 's the Difference, Really?**
If I removed the party affiliation and name from the above sets of comments, you would have a difficult time distinguishing the Republican Congressman from the Democratic Governor. This is why I say that painfully and sadly, when it comes to Islamophobia and anti-Muslim hate, we are in a tale of two complicities.
This isn't a political issue--it's a moral one. And as Democrats hit their lowest approval ratings in over 30 years, the last thing leaders like Shapiro should be doing is targeting allies like Mamdani--who by the way has among _the highest approval rating of any Democratic politician in the country._
Shapiro, and the other Democratic establishment leaders who refuse to endorse Mamdani (Schumer, Jeffries, etc.), should be listening to Mamdani. Following his lead. Standing for peace and justice--not joining Republicans in Islamophobic dog whistles. Especially when you see that they're condemning Mamdani exactly for the reasons he won--by focusing on working families, opposing genocide, and demanding justice.

---|---|---
The bottom line is this. If our values only apply when it's politically convenient, then they aren't values at all. And if we fail to condemn both Fine and Shapiro, then we've already failed the test of our times. And this is a test we cannot afford to fail.

* **TOP NEWS**

**" Texas Republicans get a bigger House edge under a new map, meeting Trump's goals," **AP's **Joey Cappelletti** , **John Hanna** and**Nadia Lathan** -- "Texas Republicans on Wednesday unveiled plans for a new U.S. House map that would deliver on President **Donald Trump 's **goal of creating more winnable GOP seats before the 2026 elections, pushing ahead with a fast and unusual summer redrawing that Democrats have few options to blunt.

The new map would create five new Republican-leaning seats that Trump is seeking as his party looks to bolster its chances of [maintaining its slim House majority.](https://substack.com/redirect/0905d92b-b2cd-4664-85ab-3ed367aa8dff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Republicans hope to pass it during a special 30-day session of the GOP-dominated Legislature called by GOP Gov. **Greg Abbott**.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/c18ac9e9-451a-4fc1-8a5b-0bb08480019b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The state's four Democratic-leaning major metropolitan areas -- where the bulk of the booming state's 30 million people live -- each would be sliced up among at least four congressional districts each under the new map, nearly all of which would be Republican-majority. One district would link a thin piece of Austin with oil-town Odessa, 340 miles to the west.

Trump had urged Texas to help the GOP, and his team has signaled that efforts could expand to other states, with a similar push underway in Missouri.

"My understanding is that there is a path forward for a Republican to win five more of those seats," said Republican state Rep. **Cody Vasut** , chair of the Texas House's redistricting committee, on the new maps.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/c18ac9e9-451a-4fc1-8a5b-0bb08480019b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Republicans hold 25 of the state's 38 seats, and the new map ups the total they could win to 30. Had the same lines been in place in 2024, Trump would have carried each of the 30 districts by at least 10 percentage points, leading to conservative optimism despite what's likely to be a tough midterm environment for the party.

**A Democratic backlash**

U.S. House Democratic Leader **Hakeem Jeffries** accused Republicans of seeking to disenfranchise Black and Hispanic communities across the state, something the GOP disputes.

Jeffries, from New York, and Democratic California Gov. **Gavin Newsom** accused Trump and Abbott of trying to rig the 2026 midterm elections.

"The American people will not let them get away with it," Jeffries said in a statement.

Democrats [are pushing](https://substack.com/redirect/ffb87d3c-25bf-48e0-ab80-690dba96eaec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in both California and New York to consider redrawing their districts as well to counter the GOP efforts.

Democrats in Texas also are considering walking out to prevent the GOP from passing new maps before the special session ends Aug. 19, though Abbott could simply call another one.

**Past efforts to squash partisan legislative action**

Legislators in Texas [and other states](https://substack.com/redirect/58ecaf64-cbf8-4d94-b058-9828f4612bbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have walked out of legislative sessions before, hoping to thwart the other party, with mixed results.

In 2003, when Texas Republicans also sought to redraw district lines in place for only one congressional election, Democrats fled to Oklahoma and New Mexico but failed to overturn the GOP plan. Republicans had taken full control of the Legislature in the 2002 elections for the first time since the 1870s, and their new congressional map allowed the GOP to pick up six seats in 2004, meaning they held 21 to the Democrats' 11.

Democratic Rep. **Lloyd Doggett** , dean of the Texas congressional delegation, said in a statement that Trump is taking a "hatchet" to his Austin district with the "sole objective of maintaining his one-man rule." Doggett would be drawn into a district with another Democrat representing Austin, Rep. **Greg Casar**.

"My sole focus is on defeating this Trump-imposed gerrymandering, which relies on crooked lines instead of honest votes," Doggett said.

Casar called the merger "illegal voter suppression." The state would go from having two districts with a piece of Austin that extend at least 100 miles into more conservative, rural areas to having three, all farther-flung.

**Proposed changes in big cities and the Rio Grande Valley**

The new seats come from making two Rio Grande Valley seats that have been narrowly won by Democrats recently slightly more Republican, collapsing the seats held by Casar and Doggett and turning two Democratic-held seats in the Dallas-Ft. Worth area into GOP-majority ones.

Linking part of liberal Austin to conservative areas far to the west mimics something Republicans did [in Kansas in 2022.](https://substack.com/redirect/5a2b0c63-62de-4abb-8c5e-65191d1d151c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Over Democratic Gov. **Laura Kelly 's** veto, they put the liberal enclave with the main University of Kansas campus, 40 miles outside Kansas City, in a district with the western two-thirds of the state.

But **Adam Kincaid** , executive director of the National Republican Redistricting Trust overseeing GOP mapmaking, defended the new Texas proposal as beneficial for minority communities in big metropolitan areas. He said the new map would create two new Black-majority seats, one in Dallas and the other in the Houston area, and one new majority Hispanic one.

"If you go through it, you're going to see that a lot of the communities that were broken up in the previous map were put together in this one," he said.

**What can New York and California do?**

Trump has been pushing for redistricting in Texas with the explicit goal of making it easier for Republicans to defend their U.S. House majority. And Democrats are limited in their options for countering the GOP's efforts.

Newsom has talked about redistricting, but an independent commission draws political boundaries.

In New York, Democrats introduced a proposal this week that would allow a new map ahead of schedule, but it would require amending the state constitution, a change that must pass the Legislature twice and be approved by voters. The soonest new lines could be in place would be 2028.

Democratic state Sen. **Michael Gianaris** , who is sponsoring the proposal, acknowledged the 2026 shortcomings of his legislation but said "we can't just sit there and watch" as Texas redraws its maps.

"There may be opportunities elsewhere but this is not a battle that's going to be over in a year," he said in a phone interview after Texas proposed its new map. "Unfortunately this is just a new front in the manipulation in our democracy to gain political advantage."" TOP NEWS " Texas Republicans get a bigger House edge under a new map, meeting Trump's goals," AP's Joey Cappelletti , John Hanna andNadia Lathan -- "Texas Republicans on Wednesday unveiled plans for a new U.S. House map that would deliver on President Donald Trump 's goal of creating more winnable GOP seats before the 2026 elections, pushing ahead with a fast and unusual summer redrawing that Democrats have few options to blunt. The new map would create five new Republican-leaning seats that Trump is seeking as his party looks to bolster its chances of Republicans hope to pass it during a special 30-day session of the GOP-dominated Legislature called by GOP Gov. Greg Abbott. The state's four Democratic-leaning major metropolitan areas -- where the bulk of the booming state's 30 million people live -- each would be sliced up among at least four congressional districts each under the new map, nearly all of which would be Republican-majority. One district would link a thin piece of Austin with oil-town Odessa, 340 miles to the west. Trump had urged Texas to help the GOP, and his team has signaled that efforts could expand to other states, with a similar push underway in Missouri. "My understanding is that there is a path forward for a Republican to win five more of those seats," said Republican state Rep. Cody Vasut , chair of the Texas House's redistricting committee, on the new maps. Republicans hold 25 of the state's 38 seats, and the new map ups the total they could win to 30. Had the same lines been in place in 2024, Trump would have carried each of the 30 districts by at least 10 percentage points, leading to conservative optimism despite what's likely to be a tough midterm environment for the party. A Democratic backlash U.S. House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries accused Republicans of seeking to disenfranchise Black and Hispanic communities across the state, something the GOP disputes. Jeffries, from New York, and Democratic California Gov. Gavin Newsom accused Trump and Abbott of trying to rig the 2026 midterm elections. "The American people will not let them get away with it," Jeffries said in a statement. Democrats in both California and New York to consider redrawing their districts as well to counter the GOP efforts. Democrats in Texas also are considering walking out to prevent the GOP from passing new maps before the special session ends Aug. 19, though Abbott could simply call another one. Past efforts to squash partisan legislative action Legislators in Texas have walked out of legislative sessions before, hoping to thwart the other party, with mixed results. In 2003, when Texas Republicans also sought to redraw district lines in place for only one congressional election, Democrats fled to Oklahoma and New Mexico but failed to overturn the GOP plan. Republicans had taken full control of the Legislature in the 2002 elections for the first time since the 1870s, and their new congressional map allowed the GOP to pick up six seats in 2004, meaning they held 21 to the Democrats' 11. Democratic Rep. Lloyd Doggett , dean of the Texas congressional delegation, said in a statement that Trump is taking a "hatchet" to his Austin district with the "sole objective of maintaining his one-man rule." Doggett would be drawn into a district with another Democrat representing Austin, Rep. Greg Casar. "My sole focus is on defeating this Trump-imposed gerrymandering, which relies on crooked lines instead of honest votes," Doggett said. Casar called the merger "illegal voter suppression." The state would go from having two districts with a piece of Austin that extend at least 100 miles into more conservative, rural areas to having three, all farther-flung. Proposed changes in big cities and the Rio Grande Valley The new seats come from making two Rio Grande Valley seats that have been narrowly won by Democrats recently slightly more Republican, collapsing the seats held by Casar and Doggett and turning two Democratic-held seats in the Dallas-Ft. Worth area into GOP-majority ones. Linking part of liberal Austin to conservative areas far to the west mimics something Republicans did Over Democratic Gov. Laura Kelly 's veto, they put the liberal enclave with the main University of Kansas campus, 40 miles outside Kansas City, in a district with the western two-thirds of the state. But Adam Kincaid , executive director of the National Republican Redistricting Trust overseeing GOP mapmaking, defended the new Texas proposal as beneficial for minority communities in big metropolitan areas. He said the new map would create two new Black-majority seats, one in Dallas and the other in the Houston area, and one new majority Hispanic one. "If you go through it, you're going to see that a lot of the communities that were broken up in the previous map were put together in this one," he said. What can New York and California do? Trump has been pushing for redistricting in Texas with the explicit goal of making it easier for Republicans to defend their U.S. House majority. And Democrats are limited in their options for countering the GOP's efforts. Newsom has talked about redistricting, but an independent commission draws political boundaries. In New York, Democrats introduced a proposal this week that would allow a new map ahead of schedule, but it would require amending the state constitution, a change that must pass the Legislature twice and be approved by voters. The soonest new lines could be in place would be 2028. Democratic state Sen. Michael Gianaris , who is sponsoring the proposal, acknowledged the 2026 shortcomings of his legislation but said "we can't just sit there and watch" as Texas redraws its maps. "There may be opportunities elsewhere but this is not a battle that's going to be over in a year," he said in a phone interview after Texas proposed its new map. "Unfortunately this is just a new front in the manipulation in our democracy to gain political advantage."" subject: A message for you
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROB BONTA FOR CALIFORNIA ATTORNEY GENERAL 2026 FPPC ID #145642]
body:
[ https://act.robbonta.com/go/4?refcode=em250730&t=1001&akid=1900%2E1088799%2E2tsaDR ]Rob Bonta

I want to share a bit about me you may not know
yet.

I was raised by social justice warriors.

My dad marched for civil rights in Selma, Alabama where he heard Martin
Luther King Jr. preach. My mom, born and raised in the Philippines, spent
years fighting for the restoration of democracy in her home country.

My parents had me while living and working in the Philippines as social
justice missionaries. I was born as a dictator was rising to power and
martial law was imminent.

It was critical to both of my parents that I grow up in a country with
democracy, freedom, rule of law, and human and civil rights — and sadly it
became clear to them that wasn’t the case in the Philippines. So they
brought my family here, to California, when I was just two months old.

A short while later, my parents began working with the United Farm Workers
of America — fighting for workers’ rights, fair pay, and shade and water
breaks alongside Dolores Huerta, Cesar Chavez, and Philip Vera Cruz.

I would never have guessed as a young kid that I would grow up to serve as
the Attorney General of California — but as long as I can remember, I’ve
known that I wanted to fight for those most vulnerable to have a fair shot
at the California Dream.

That’s why I do this work. I know, without a doubt, that the California
Dream is alive and well because I’m living mine — and I’m committed to
using every bit of platform and power I have to lift people up and fight
for justice for all.

I’ll be on the ballot for re-election next year, and I want nothing more
than to continue this fight.

California needs an Attorney General who will stand up to those who abuse
their power — whether it’s corrupt politicians, corporate polluters,
extremist groups trying to roll back our rights, or powerful interests
that exploit workers, cheat consumers, and put profits ahead of people.

before the end of July? Every single donation helps us build a stronger
grassroots movement to protect our freedoms.

Thanks very much for your support. It means a lot to me to have you on

clean_body: [ ]Rob Bonta I want to share a bit about me you may not know yet. I was raised by social justice warriors. My dad marched for civil rights in Selma, Alabama where he heard Martin Luther King Jr. preach. My mom, born and raised in the Philippines, spent years fighting for the restoration of democracy in her home country. My parents had me while living and working in the Philippines as social justice missionaries. I was born as a dictator was rising to power and martial law was imminent. It was critical to both of my parents that I grow up in a country with democracy, freedom, rule of law, and human and civil rights — and sadly it became clear to them that wasn’t the case in the Philippines. So they brought my family here, to California, when I was just two months old. A short while later, my parents began working with the United Farm Workers of America — fighting for workers’ rights, fair pay, and shade and water breaks alongside Dolores Huerta, Cesar Chavez, and Philip Vera Cruz. I would never have guessed as a young kid that I would grow up to serve as the Attorney General of California — but as long as I can remember, I’ve known that I wanted to fight for those most vulnerable to have a fair shot at the California Dream. That’s why I do this work. I know, without a doubt, that the California Dream is alive and well because I’m living mine — and I’m committed to using every bit of platform and power I have to lift people up and fight for justice for all. I’ll be on the ballot for re-election next year, and I want nothing more than to continue this fight. subject: Join the fight against Critical Race Theory
body:
Now, CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq890a59qprtgvn19heu41p9qlu40r5d0rpbi1s8_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjim6o34cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zb8aj6fo8hgmhufb7funr7gog1cbl4ndgjihmcjg_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjim6o34cth2bs)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zve3ma8di4ldi50res7op1d6tu1suc9rmg8i08hg_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjim6o34cth2bs)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuo8n67bfvatkpuq68dqc7umqikabu38b8kbs7i0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjim6o34cth2bs)

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GGl7cnNDmmEcngJdI2Kcgw~~/AARclBA~/dSCi_JbId3EK_9T0wCSYKr4bypPFjBYnWOG8MsKpd1VTYnrgFaq64cn4v6_4lrlBvYgDfh54twxOh4Jw1T6ODo2EA8OV7Lc2nH4K0KiyBYDqpV53HzSqONntdwns3kjsIzSc8kR3QIHeG35E4hQhQbu1xCnM3jOWdB5rknYgvhT33_H1mrKNDyMQEXwrQBLMt-JtWy3k6QpCYZOSRI1wYgKEm20qYlp568QWWpNsA4GxRoCq2jT0xDlBYCOPaEW7m9XuGxvsi-jmqVyHH9839CT0hV1hUqAh5QEuxKpQ-tI~)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GGl7cnNDmmEcngJdI2Kcgw~~/AARclBA~/dSCi_JbId3EK_9T0wCSYKr4bypPFjBYnWOG8MsKpd1VTYnrgFaq64cn4v6_4lrlBvYgDfh54twxOh4Jw1T6ODo2EA8OV7Lc2nH4K0KiyBYDqpV53HzSqONntdwns3kjsIzSc8kR3QIHeG35E4hQhQbu1xCnM3jOWdB5rknYgvhT33_H1mrKNDyMQEXwrQBLMt-JtWy3k6QpCYZOSRI1wYgKEm20qYlp568QWWpNsA4GxRoCq2jT0xDlBYCOPaEW7m9XuGxvsi-jmqVyHH9839CT0hV1hUqAh5QEuxKpQ-tI~)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GGl7cnNDmmEcngJdI2Kcgw~~/AARclBA~/dSCi_JbId3EK_9T0wCSYKr4bypPFjBYnWOG8MsKpd1VTYnrgFaq64cn4v6_4lrlBvYgDfh54twxOh4Jw1T6ODo2EA8OV7Lc2nH4K0KiyBYDqpV53HzSqONntdwns3kjsIzSc8kR3QIHeG35E4hQhQbu1xCnM3jOWdB5rknYgvhT33_H1mrKNDyMQEXwrQBLMt-JtWy3k6QpCYZOSRI1wYgKEm20qYlp568QWWpNsA4GxRoCq2jT0xDlBYCOPaEW7m9XuGxvsi-jmqVyHH9839CT0hV1hUqAh5QEuxKpQ-tI~)

The government is [partnering with major tech firms](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOiOzjvFd4eIaulx7JdrY67Ang5G9Ccrb_-J_hb8baTSjme_ffbkjZ96ff3EjL6ksO50tkwjV5dUolL1sn2ctZ6sYuWAQftMCGqzSTplxicj5s9z66BMRkOnJj86a33YanelXD4aSw0m7YCcXbEgJJhtgtMY5N2Hq2V9t2plx1BosDI_oIJBJNsEv87Cmu2mKLKUO_wvvslLKn_KmOoSy9dmvIkfrzJ8O5g7m8zyH8GjXi8vvYL5kB7PU13YojBvv3KSicNmVUFhVKNuBO1NTK2GWVQWspCIKKgyB2pXuq4_HyTlzm1x3088NOX8PkB9Re3v4CgAA__9JVIO-), including Google, Amazon, Apple, Oracle, and Microsoft, as well as healthcare giants like UnitedHealth Group and CVS Health, to share patient data across the system. The initial focus is on diabetes and weight management, but the program aims over time to modernize Medicare's digital tools and improve data-sharing across systems. Officials said patients will benefit from a system that allows them to call up their records across systems, but privacy advocates warned that the program raises ethical and legal concerns about the ways in which those medical records could be used.

## Screwworm Within 400 Miles of Texas
The parasitic New World screwworm has been reported less than 400 miles from McAllen, raising alarms that it could spread to Texas in [as little as four months](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO8yAUBODT2B0RD2wDBcXfpMvfbmkReNhI2FjwNk5uv0qKvcDWI32ama_bfHMpp3357za09Ixl3vFsGYmwzs1XPM9StwWp-Vwa1tP50sIsuBgZV0zCHFzKr3nog73zYKBHC2qUZjSTkf1qFRg9Gq_0XXjQJjp1n2AwYGKctMTQJ_vGuJIAwEHyixB6BDnIaQTNYZi6gWNIVOqFViR8uhbzqzywXnzZ-mxXoqN18l8nrp24HliOjO-oE9e11Jpi8ixmbCtDR2lf2OGqa4mQregCBkaFfTf2kZl3RBnZ73IWc8LGAJTmAnhfbTjOlHNqk-oGvmwu5U8P-tt7Dyt-AgAA__9EgoTZ). name: Roy Cooper
subject: I’m officially in the race for U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats
body:
I have thought on it and prayed about it, and I have decided. I’m in.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93048?refcode=em20250731-9203&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9203%2E614464%2EPeOies)
**[I’m Roy Cooper. I’m a proud Democrat. I’m also a former Governor and Attorney General from North Carolina. Today, I’m asking for your support to be the next United States Senator and help Democrats take BACK the Senate Majority in 2026. If you’re ready to join me in the fight, split a contribution between State Democrats Committee and my campaign today >>>](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93048?refcode=em20250731-9203&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9203%2E614464%2EPeOies)**
**North Carolinians already know this about me, Peter:** I’ve spent my life in service to our state, and my record shows that I will do everything in my power to deliver results for our people.
That’s why North Carolinians elected me Governor in some of the most competitive races in the nation — _twice._
Now, this election is set to be the most competitive Senate race of 2026, and the national GOP will go to any lengths to defeat us. Everyone knows that the path to retaking the Senate Majority and STOPPING Washington Republicans starts here in NC.
**[If we’re going to win, we need Democrats from across this country to join our fight. I hope to see your name on the list of Founding Donors starting our campaign off strong, and just $10 will go a long way. Can I count on you to split a contribution of any size right away?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93048?refcode=em20250731-9203&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=9203%2E614464%2EPeOies)**
Peter, I have a long record of getting things done — from taking on big banks as Attorney General to getting Medicaid expansion passed when I was Governor.
I’m not afraid of doing hard work to make our country better. _And I’m not afraid to speak out when politicians are doing something wrong, either._
Too many Republicans in Washington have lost all sense of duty to our people and our country. They see only the prospect of getting on Donald Trump’s wrong side and losing their power. **This cannot continue.**
Americans deserve leaders who will serve the people, not their own partisan agenda.
_Meanwhile, Donald Trump has handpicked a loyalist candidate to run against me._
As Senator, I will defend our democracy. I’ll stand up for voting rights, work hard to restore abortion access, advocate for policies that will protect our air and drinking water, and do everything possible to bring jobs and opportunity to our economy.
**[My promise to you is that I will always do what I think is right for the people of our great country. Peter, we can win this race, but it won’t be easy. I need you with me as a Founding Donor today. Does a $10 donation, split between our Senate campaign and State Democrats Committee, fit in your budget today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93048?refcode=em20250731-9203&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=9203%2E614464%2EPeOies)**

name: Sen. Jeff Bridges
subject: Two Summits in one week!
body:
This isn't just a milestone for MIHA, it's a meaningful step toward solving Colorado’s housing crisis

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/5b211c87fa34/get-more-smarter-on-colorados-budget-10368012?e=b48bb2b4f4)
---
[|
---](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=e031abf7a9&e=b48bb2b4f4)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there,
Last week I visited Summit County _twice_!
Once to receive a Legislator of the Year award from the Colorado Association of School Executives (CASE) for the work I’ve done to fund our K-12 public schools.
And the other for a middle income housing groundbreaking in downtown Frisco. It’s the very first one for Colorado’s Middle Income Housing Authority (MIHA), which I created a few years ago as the first and still only statewide housing authority focused on ensuring middle income folks—like nurses, teachers, and firefighters—can afford to live in the communities they serve.
---
|
---
| This isn't just a milestone for MIHA, it's a meaningful step toward solving Colorado’s housing crisis and it’s a blueprint for how I’ll invest in housing as Colorado’s next Treasurer.
Some of the folks at the groundbreaking actually opposed the MIHA bill back when I passed it! But in true Colorado fashion, we put our heads together, got the job done, and now we're building homes that hard working Coloradans can afford.
I would love to talk more about how the Treasurer can build homes that Coloradans can afford. [Let’s talk it over at a Saturday cereal brunch!](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=7826ea9a40&e=b48bb2b4f4) Starting at 10:30am on August 23rd, it’s an all-you-can-eat bonanza with dozens of different cereals.
---
| [CLICK FOR CEREAL](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=0dd50ad6fc&e=b48bb2b4f4)
---
| Text me at (303) 358-5551 to make sure I include your favorite cereal in the mix!
Talk soon,

P.S. MIHA’s Chair, Peter LiFari, made some beautiful comments at the groundbreaking: “Colorado’s middle-income workforce has been priced out of the very places they make function. They earn too much to qualify for traditional affordable housing, and too little to compete in a market that has rapidly left them behind. Galena Apartments is a direct response to this challenge that brings more than just supply. It brings proximity to opportunity and happiness, and delivers on our foundational human need to belong. Galena is housing. Galena is place-making. Galena is what public purpose looks like in bricks and sticks.” ❤️
---
|

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Never expected this.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I never would have thought that the people who stormed the Capitol that day, who violently assaulted police officers, would go free two years later.
#

Hey, Peter.
While I was on patrol as a Marine in Iraq, while my brothers and I were in combat, while my friends were being wounded and killed... I never would’ve expected that nearly 20 years later I’d have to be ready to fight to defend our democracy on the floor of the House of Representatives.
And as I stood on the House floor on January 6th, teaching my colleagues how to use gas masks, texting my staff on where to hide and how to keep safe, getting ready to defend myself... I never would have thought that the people who stormed the Capitol that day, who violently assaulted police officers, would go free two years later.
But on his first day in office, President Trump pardoned and commuted sentences for every single one of the January 6th rioters. And that was just the start.
In the months since, Trump illegally disbanded independent agencies aimed at holding his White house accountable. Deported legal residents without due process. Ignored direct orders from the Supreme Court. He rammed through a budget gutting care for the sick, the elderly, for veterans, in exchange for massive tax cuts for billionaires and millionaires.
It's a lot, and it’s okay to be worried right now.
Here’s something I believe, though: This country is stronger than the actions of any one person, even the president. And if we stick together, we’ll make it through this.
I’ve always been lucky to have friends, family, and a community that had my back. I would not have been able to build a life for myself without them. I would not have gotten into Harvard, or survived Iraq without them.
I am serving in the United States Senate to deliver for them — and for you.
[**If you’re with me, it’d mean a lot if you could chip in $5 or $10 to my campaign. We’ve got a lot of work to do to fight back, and donations like this are how we keep up the pressure.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july25.UmJNyp&refcode=em250731-1-90&t=1&akid=3932%2E734936%2EQ30Q5Y)

Peter, it's Wes Moore. **Republicans have made it clear: defeating me is one of their primary goals in 2026.**
We’ve made incredible progress in Maryland — from funding our schools to improving public safety — but Trump Republicans want to roll it all back.
**Here's what they don’t understand: I don’t back down from a fight.** I ran for governor to make this Maryland’s decade. And that’s exactly what I’m doing now.
**[Join me in this mission by pitching in $5 before our end-of-month deadline tonight.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250731-1?amount=5&refcode=em-20250731-1&refcode2=392_1086043_Oc9voV&akid=392%2E1086043%2EOc9voV)**

Peter,

God works in mysterious ways.

Today, I felt discouraged. The political process can do that to you, especially when fighting against a system that keeps outsiders like me out.

**But just when I needed it the most, He sent a sign.**

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=94b7a8ee881c4075bd2fe0a9fc4c262a&_e=08PaEQ0mIYni-y3-JpmktGCSEqncUz3mPWTtLzoB9r3ToAMCWzIXsk-9W8UYh-rugJZFpwomlzCdLqT7HOOzdcoqySle6iD9Gotonhrb8M_3mlvjz8O2YMnTaMIdICj-e--g-eBypVdKiFDyRqiWJw66A01K8YF0wM1goPZqGCn1EF2zEiRb02HnuzKEtILS-AXd1TsAzZtrkz00zRG80Zx6PcxXojwuUZsfNkWvtwue3NWDKs9UyOYCEqHaXDtROGVKMpEWDTpmyNvCFBfKAhRJ9vxQc2fl5HjI5dPTcertiKK-U7pfAzPzHWSzoWR7UZi9ooMBVZcy_OVxCHWN3fjM-7V5m7yJ7EP1Mdyhg3kXsv2hNGkZyU_e696R5EN8-e-2n0-N1fS4DFS7EmW1GdaKyHL16Gb3YcPzRoSrcCLruysGr0sWvfaS65aLna3tK2Ak7MatuouMdEfmLEYPmAas2DJ5iIooeTLiGBRktk0YgxDeA1kdUD52YL6On8uQ5yzNigMv_xy-as0vabk_8ZALb-x9U8mxIRLY3Tmuu48%3D)
At the gym here in the Twin Cities, folks, Black and White came up to me and said, "I'm voting for you. I'm proud of you."
That's all I needed to hear.

Because **Minnesota isn't lost, the Twin Cities aren't lost.**
They're only lost if we give up the will to fight.

**I believe in God. I believe in Minnesota. I believe in YOU.**

I need your support.
| | | It's Senator Schumer. This is a long email -- but because of how much is at stake, _you need to know it all._

**If you can't read the whole thing, I'll cut to the chase:**

**[The GOP wants to use their majority to implement ALL of Trump's most extreme policy goals. I wish I was exaggerating, but I'm not. So please, will you chip in $5 _(becomes $15!)_ before tonight's end-of-month deadline to take back the Senate?](https://go.dscc.org/go/21934?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20250731-ChuckSchumer-SchumerLongForm2026RF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20250731-ChuckSchumer-SchumerLongForm2026RF-Pros-sl1&akid=20876%2E9716520%2Ect62qD)**

_Here are the three most important things you need to know:_

**SENATE REPUBLICANS ARE WORKING HAND-IN-HAND WITH TRUMP TO PASS HIS PLANS INTO LAW.**

Now that they have the majority, they're doing whatever it takes to cater to Trump's desires -- even if it means cutting key programs like Medicaid and Social Security!

_It gets worse:_

**EXPERTS ARE SAYING TAKING THE SENATE BACK WILL BE TOUGH.**

If we want to stop Trump's agenda, we'll NEED to take back the Senate -- but the analysts are saying it'll be an uphill battle. Factor in the Republican megadonors willing to spend hundreds of millions to keep the Senate red, and it's clear we won't have much margin for error.

_As a result:_

**WE'LL NEED ALL HANDS ON DECK TO DEFY THE ODDS AND TAKE BACK THE MAJORITY!**

It'll be a tough fight, but I know it can be done. We can only beat the odds if grassroots Democrats like you step up. **So please:**

**[We _NEED_ to fight back and act with urgency, so before today's end-of-month deadline, will you give $5 _(becomes $15!)_ to win back the Senate?](https://go.dscc.org/go/21934?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20250731-ChuckSchumer-SchumerLongForm2026RF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20250731-ChuckSchumer-SchumerLongForm2026RF-Pros-sl1&akid=20876%2E9716520%2Ect62qD)**

name: Andy Ngo
subject: Help me bring Antifa to justice
body:
I was one of the first savagely beaten by lawless, violent Antifa thugs

| |
---
| |
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zen62cd0kc7874dp5q0qpgg0vv9otmkmcat175kg_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjgeepb6c9h2bs)
---
My fellow concerned American, I was one of the first savagely beaten by lawless, violent Antifa thugs.And unless we do something to stop them today, I won’t be the last. **[I’m asking you to donate $35 or more today to help me bring Antifa and its members who assaulted me to justice.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z0847q1hiu648kloormm4l75vp4qcrtbmhtulsio_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjgeepb6c9h2bs) ****I was at Antifa's "ground zero" in Portland, Oregon during the summer of 2019.** This was before most Americans had ever heard of the Antifa movement, but they'd caused havoc and violence before.I went to an Antifa "protest" as a journalist to document and report on their “protest.”As soon as I arrived, I feared for my safety.The mob was angry, and violence always follows Antifa. Most of them wore masks to prevent being identified when they commit crimes. Many had on helmets and carried riot gear. Some, I later learned, secretly had weapons like baseball bats, brass knuckles and even bricks.I was scared, but I had a job to do, so I pressed on.**People like you needed to know what was happening.** But I didn't go unnoticed for long.Somebody recognized me and bashed me on the back of my head in an ambush."F*** you, Andy Ngo!" shouted voices around me. "Go home, fascist!"**Fists started flying at my face and head. Then came the projectiles.** Before I knew it, I was being repeatedly punched, kicked, and hit with objects.I tried to protect my head. I did not strike back as I knew that would only escalate the situation and put me in more danger.The thugs robbed me of my camera so that I wouldn’t have evidence of the assault. What they did to me is unacceptable and criminal. And now they're trying to do the same to other innocent Americans like you.That's why I sued members of the Rose City Antifa organization to bring them to justice and send the loud clear message that they are NOT above the law.Now I need your help to hold their feet to the fire and make sure justice is served. [**Will you donate $35 or more to help me hold Antifa accountable?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zmvn1dsftlknudescdbj1kfqtjf1nvmehajn7em8_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjgeepb6c9h2bs) This is bigger than me alone. After I got away from the mob, police finally showed up when I was in the hospital. But my attackers stole my evidence and nearly silenced me permanently with a traumatic brain injury.Later, cell phone footage from a bystander surfaced online. Thank goodness! The video captured part of the attack, clear as day.I hoped I'd get the justice I deserved.Wrong.To this day, six years later, the Portland Police have done nothing.**No charges. No arrests. No suspects questioned.** It's not much of a surprise, though.Radical politicians have long since bowed to the dangerous left-wing mobs that terrorize their streets. That’s why the Center for American Liberty helped me file a lawsuit against my attackers. A judge ordered three of them to pay damages – but more than a year later and they have not paid a dime.So now the Center for American Liberty is helping me track them down and make them pay for nearly killing me and trampling upon the First Amendment.Unfortunately it’s going to cost at least $20,000 to get justice.[**That's why I hope you'll join the fight by donating $35 or more to fund my efforts to hold Antifa and its members accountable.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zvfgmcka13po29t4vuukdqdqhbt7ktod1ma0ldq0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjgeepb6c9h2bs) We have to stop Antifa and make them face real, legal consequences for their destructive actions before they get to you and your family.Antifa wants the literal end of America -- and they'll stop at nothing to get it. Believe me when I say that's not an overstatement. Some members are avowed socialists or communists. But many are much worse – open violent anarchists who want to tear down civilization and remake it in their own twisted vision with no law and order.By any means necessary.**_Rioting. Destruction. Mayhem._** And they know, as long as they choose politically favored protests to co-opt, the media and politicians will never have the guts to denounce their violence or hold them accountable. They did that with BLM. They’re doing it now against ICE.It's a sick strategy, but very smart – because so far, they've been successful.**For the most part, they've gotten off scot-free.** Our politicians and media are treating this terrorist group like peaceful protestors!As we saw in Los Angeles earlier this summer, their riots will only spread and intensify if Antifa continue to escape consequences.**So now I'm taking justice into my own hands – with the help of the talented lawyers at the Center for American Liberty.**

[**You can be a part of bringing Antifa to justice with a donation of $35 or more today.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z3bmhkf3hgroh8buaboo4bu2gk70o34ikm37p0r0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjgeepb6c9h2bs) Though I'm seeking justice for myself, the impact of this case could be so much larger.This is about standing up for our country when our own leaders won't.This is about saving America as we know it and keeping you and your family safe.And this is just the first blow we intend to deliver.By taking them to court for the attack against me we can prove they are NOT untouchable. **[Can I count on you to donate $35 or more to help me get justice from Antifa?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7tpr07spdbppae5t25t751636fmiucnetvkf4i0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6cjgeepb6c9h2bs) **Please don't wait – if we don't fight back and win now, **these violent thugs will be in EVERY city across America** , destroying everything and everyone in their path. Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| | Sincerely,
---

---
**Andy Ngo**

|

I wish I could tell them that hard work still gets rewarded. That doing the right thing means something. That the people in charge are fighting for them. But I can’t say that. Because it wouldn’t be true. We’re raising kids in a country where wages are stuck, rent is skyrocketing, childcare is out of control, and one accident or illness can wreck a family’s future. And while families like mine are scraping to get by, do you know what our current representative is doing? **Posting memes. Picking fights. Embarrassing us on the national stage.** Lauren Boebert isn’t fighting for your kids. She’s fighting for attention. She’s a walking culture war distraction while the real issues — housing, wages, healthcare, rural poverty — go completely ignored. Meanwhile, my kids are growing up watching the news, seeing school shootings, seeing wars, seeing people living in tents and wondering: “Why does it feel like nobody cares?” I wish I could tell them their leaders are doing everything they can. But Boebert’s not. She’s not leading. She’s chasing headlines, not solutions. She’s performing, not serving. **That’s why I’m running.** **[Will you chip in before our deadline to help us send Boebert packing and build something clean_body: | | | Friend, There’s a lot I wish I could tell my kids about this country. I wish I could tell them that hard work still gets rewarded. That doing the right thing means something. That the people in charge are fighting for them. But I can’t say that. Because it wouldn’t be true. We’re raising kids in a country where wages are stuck, rent is skyrocketing, childcare is out of control, and one accident or illness can wreck a family’s future. And while families like mine are scraping to get by, do you know what our current representative is doing? Posting memes. Picking fights. Embarrassing us on the national stage. Lauren Boebert isn’t fighting for your kids. She’s fighting for attention. She’s a walking culture war distraction while the real issues — housing, wages, healthcare, rural poverty — go completely ignored. Meanwhile, my kids are growing up watching the news, seeing school shootings, seeing wars, seeing people living in tents and wondering: “Why does it feel like nobody cares?” I wish I could tell them their leaders are doing everything they can. But Boebert’s not. She’s not leading. She’s chasing headlines, not solutions. She’s performing, not serving. That’s why I’m running. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: Boebert’s made this district a punchline. I want to make it a place we’re proud to raise our kids in again. In solidarity, John Padora Democratic Candidate for Congress, CO-04 John Padora is a manufacturing engineer and candidate for Congress in Colorado’s 4th District. He’s running to bring commonsense leadership to Eastern Colorado—fighting for farmers, working families, and real solutions, not political theater. Paid for by Padora for Colorado

body:

Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Joining forces with allies to condemn Trump's redistricting takeover of Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Small%20gerrymander%20banner%20-%20redistricting.JPG]
Trump and Abbott's racist redistricting ploy is facing FIERCE resistance in the Lone Star State.
On Monday, Dallas TOP members and staff joined hundreds of Texans gathered at UT Arlington [https://www.keranews.org/government/2025-07-29/north-texans-democrats-rally-ahead-of-redistricting-hearing-at-uta] in near 100 degree heat to rally, speak out, and fight back against Donald Trump and Greg Abbott's discriminatory plan to rig congressional district maps to lock in GOP political power. This “Fight the Trump Takeover” event brought together progressive organizations with the Texas For All coalition, elected officials, and grassroots community leaders committed to protecting fair electoral representation for each and every Texan.
WATCH the livestream of the rally here. [https://www.facebook.com/watch/live/?ref=watch_permalink&v=1045333350917948]
Instead of focusing on flood recovery, the increased cost of living, or other real needs of Texans, our governor has centered his special session on pushing Trump’s authoritarian agenda. This mid-decade congressional district redraw, with no new census data or mandate, is a clear-cut act of racial gerrymandering. It’s unethical and illegal. In coordination with our movement allies across the state, TOP will continue pushing back against this blatant Republican power grab.
For more information about how you can join our fight against this GOP redistricting scheme, contact David at dvillalobos@organizetexas.org [dvillalobos@organizetexas.org] .
Speaking out to protect the rights of our immigrant families and communities
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20City%20Council%20meeting%20TOP%20-%20July%202025.jpg]
As the Trump administration continues to demonize and aggressively target immigrant families, TOP and Houston immigrant justice allies are stepping up to voice our support for their fundamental rights.
On Tuesday, we teamed up to pack Houston City Hall with Houston Leads, Woori Juntos, DSA Houston, and other passionate community members, to share personal stories of Houstonians impacted by ICE's increasingly inhumane detention and deportation tactics.
Sign Houston Leads' 'Dignity Not Deportation' online petition [https://houston-leads.org/current-campaigns/] if you agree the City of Houston must do MORE to look out for the rights of immigrants and protect them from inhumane targeting.
For more information about this effort, email Damaris at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .

El plan racista de Trump y Abbott para manipular el rediseño distrital enfrenta una FUERTE resistencia en el estado de la estrella solitaria.
El lunes, miembros y personal de TOP en Dallas se unieron a cientos de texanos que se reunieron en la Universidad de Texas en Arlington [https://www.keranews.org/government/2025-07-29/north-texans-democrats-rally-ahead-of-redistricting-hearing-at-uta] , soportando casi 100 grados de calor, para manifestarse, alzar la voz y luchar contra el plan discriminatorio de Donald Trump y Greg Abbott para manipular los distritos congresionales y asegurar el poder político del Partido Republicano. Este evento, llamado “Lucha contra la toma de poder de Trump”, reunió a organizaciones progresistas de la coalición Texas For All, funcionarios electos y líderes comunitarios comprometidos con proteger una representación electoral justa para todos los texanos.
VEA la transmisión en vivo del mitin aquí. [https://www.facebook.com/watch/live/?ref=watch_permalink&v=1045333350917948]
En lugar de enfocarse en la recuperación tras inundaciones, el aumento del costo de vida u otras necesidades reales del pueblo texano, nuestro gobernador ha centrado su sesión especial en impulsar la agenda autoritaria de Trump. name: Elizabeth Nader
subject: Booker is at it again…
body:
Peter, So I came across this tweet from our favorite Senator a few days ago and...well...it’s just weird guys!
| | [ ]()
---
Peter, So I came across this tweet from our favorite Senator a few days ago and...well...it’s just weird guys!
---
|
---
“The hands that feed us...” 🤨 I may have simultaneously cringed, laughed, and spit out my coffee on this one. Has Senator Booker – the great savior of illegal immigrants – just reduced them all to the people picking our vegetables? Senator, I don’t think that’s the lift-up you think it is. Setting aside that we shouldn’t turn a blind eye to lawbreaking, this is a very strange way to advocate for the open border position. And yeah, I’m here for the comments. _"It's not what you can do for the country, but what the illegals can do for you"
__“Democrats love their slave labor!”
_ _“Weird way to say that you support slave labor. This is the Democrat Party in 2025.”
_ _“This video is pretty cringe. If I was latino I would be beyond insulted.”
_ _“Who’s gonna pick our cotton?”- Democrats circa 1850”
_ _"We will fight to continue exploiting you"
__“Asparagus is overrated.”_ Guys, Common Sense is dead with our Senator. I mean, we were pretty sure. But this is conclusive evidence. What are your favorite Booker-isms? Send them my way! For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader
---
| [ ]()
---
President
Common Sense Club
---
|
---

CBS: Experts warn the proposed SAVE Act could make it harder for some married women to vote. Here's who could be affected. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=073125_1&amount=25]
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point.
PITCH IN $25 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=073125_1&amount=25]
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

| Peter,
---

I am not running for Congress to climb a political ladder or play nice with the establishment. I am running to fight for Nevada! I have seen what goes on behind the scenes in Washington. The lobbyists. The special interests. The backroom deals that leave everyday Americans behind. That is not who I am, and it is not who I will ever be.
---
|
---
When I get to Congress, I will not owe favors to anyone. I will answer only to the people of Nevada. My loyalty is not to DC insiders. It is to you. Our state deserves someone who will stand up and speak the truth. Someone who will protect our elections, defend our freedoms, and fight for policies that put America First. I have done it before, and I am ready to do it again. Let's take our country back. Let's send DC a message: Nevada is not for sale, not now or ever.

clean_body: I’m not going to DC to make friends. I’m going to fight for us. | | | | | == | Peter, I am not running for Congress to climb a political ladder or play nice with the establishment. I am running to fight for Nevada! I have seen what goes on behind the scenes in Washington. The lobbyists. The special interests. The backroom deals that leave everyday Americans behind. That is not who I am, and it is not who I will ever be. | When I get to Congress, I will not owe favors to anyone. I will answer only to the people of Nevada. My loyalty is not to DC insiders. It is to you. Our state deserves someone who will stand up and speak the truth. Someone who will protect our elections, defend our freedoms, and fight for policies that put America First. I have done it before, and I am ready to do it again. Let's take our country back. _**“SHE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN”**_
Friend, in the critical upcoming special election for Florida’s U.S. Senate seat, I am honored to tell you that **I just received President Trump’s total and complete endorsement!**
**My name is Ashley Moody, and I’ve been serving in the U.S. Senate on a temporary basis since Marco Rubio became our top diplomat – _but now it’s time to win this seat outright. _**
I’m a fifth-generation Floridian, former judge and Attorney General, wife of a law enforcement officer, and mother to two wonderful boys.
W _e can win this seat, but to be honest, history is stacked against us._
**Typically, the president’s party averages a FOUR-SEAT LOSS in Senate midterm elections. If that happens, say hello to Majority Leader Chuck Schumer and goodbye to any forward movement on President Trump’s agenda.**

\----------- Forwarded message ---------
_
“This is a political consultant’s dream, because your message is just one thing,**and that’s ‘No.’** ”_

**That was a direct quote from a Republican political consultant regarding the retention elections for three PA Supreme Court justices set to take place in November, fellow activist. **

As a reminder, three PA Supreme Court justices (elected as Democrats) are seeking to retain their seats after their ten-year term. PA has non-partisan judicial retention elections. On Election Day in PA, voters will vote “yes” or “no” to decide whether to keep these justices on the bench. If MAGA is successful with their anti-retention campaign, the PA Supreme Court could have three vacancies until the Governor can appoint and confirm their replacements (which is unlikely, as this would require support from Republicans in the PA Senate) or until the next judicial election in 2027.

As _Metro Philadelphia_ recently reported, **Republicans see these elections as their best chance to reverse our Democratic majority on the PA Supreme Court and establish a MAGA-controlled court.** This would have a drastic impact on the future of PA: “This would pave the way for very different judicial decisions. Many of the court’s recent election-related rulings were made on narrow 4-3 votes that could swing differently if the composition of the court changes.”

State supreme courts are critical – which is why the GOP is working overtime to replace Democrat-elected justices ahead of the 2026 presidential elections. State supreme courts impact everything from voting rights to reproductive rights, environmental protections, redistricting, and much more. There are only 100 days left until Election Day, and we need to ensure that voters in PA understand what’s at stake.

Their goal? To implement a MAGA majority ahead of the 2026 presidential election. As a reminder, three PA Supreme Court justices (elected as Democrats) are seeking to retain their seats after their ten-year term. PA has non-partisan judicial retention elections. On Election Day in PA, voters will vote “yes” or “no” to decide whether to keep these justices on the bench. If MAGA is successful with their anti-retention campaign, the PA Supreme Court could have three vacancies until the Governor can appoint and confirm their replacements (which is unlikely, as this would require support from Republicans in the PA Senate) or until the next judicial election in 2027. This would have a drastic impact on the future of PA: “This would pave the way for very different judicial decisions. name: Eleni Kounalakis
subject: The field is officially set, so I’m personally asking for your support of my campaign.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Eleni Kounalakis for Governor 2026
body:
Eleni Kounalakis for Governor Logo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP01/1/62802/images/ekg-logomark-min.png]

Peter,

As you may have heard, Kamala Harris has announced that she is not running for governor.

First and foremost, I want to thank her for her years of service to our state and our country. I also want to express my sincere gratitude for her friendship and the support and wisdom she gave me when I ran to become the first woman to serve as Lieutenant Governor of California.

I also know that she is not leaving the fight for our shared values. She cares deeply about our home. I look forward to what she’ll do next and will continue to cheer her on every step of the way.

But this means the field is officially set. This race is going to kick into overdrive right now.

I know from conversations with many of you this year that many folks were waiting for this decision, and I appreciate that committing to support any candidate is a big decision. I’m deeply grateful to those who have already contributed.

My resolve has never changed. I’m running for governor because I believe in California — in the people who power it, the values that guide it, and the promise it holds for every single person who calls this state home. So if you have been waiting for the right moment to donate, I’m personally asking for your support today.

Please consider making a contribution of any amount you can afford to my campaign for governor. Your support could not come at a more important time. I’m counting on you to help demonstrate the depth of support for our movement. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eleni-em-25q3?refcode2=78a58433-256e-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b]

The challenges facing our state are steep, and I have exactly the right experience to tackle them.

Trump and Republican politicians from Texas to Washington are attempting to dismantle democratic institutions. They are using their power to line the pockets of their friends and donors.

Working people are looking for a champion for their family. They need someone who will fight to bring the California Dream within reach for the next generation.

As Lieutenant Governor, professional diplomat, and former businesswoman, I bring a unique combination of decisive leadership, experienced problem-solving, and much-needed diplomacy to this fight. I pledge to work with all Californians and all stakeholders to ensure a brighter future.

I don’t take anyone’s support for granted. When I launched this campaign, I knew it would be a tough fight and require me to give all of myself to show that I will be a governor for all Californians.

If I’ve earned your support, please consider contributing anything you can spare today. We need to send a powerful message about the strength of our campaign, and every donation helps do just that. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eleni-em-25q3?refcode2=78a58433-256e-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b]

I am so grateful for your support! And I will never forget all of you who stood by my side when we were just getting started.

I’m ready to win this race ahead. And I’m ready to lead California. In 2026, we will break California’s glass ceiling.

I hope you’re ready because I can’t wait to do this together.

Best,

Eleni Kounalakis

body:

# [Don't let Texas Republicans steal the House through redistricting. Tell Democrats to "fight fire with fire"](https://default.salsalabs.org/T954bafc5-4adb-4865-b66e-3a1f2a8ea017/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T775654f4-4aef-48c7-b289-0ccb5fbc48b0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Texas Republicans are frantically rushing to redraw Congressional districts to hand an additional 5 seats to Republicans, and help Trump keep the House in GOP control. And other Republican-controlled states are looking to do the same. It goes against history (the maps are typically redrawn every 10 years, after the census), and likely violates the Voting Rights Act. And it could mean the difference between a Democratic held House that reinstalls the guardrails against Trump, and a Republican held one that essentially makes him a dictator. [**Which is why Democrats need to do whatever they can in states they control to help out Democratic candidates. Re-draw the districts ASAP, and do whatever else we can to defeat as many Republicans as possible.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5ecaea02-58de-4d7a-ab19-608e022da695/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) In an ideal world, we'd work together to ensure sensible districts and fair rules to make elections about ideas and policies, not blind party loyalty. But Republicans have gone off the deep end, and couldn't give a damn about fairness or even democracy itself. And when you're in a boxing match and the other guy steps into the ring with a chainsaw, you better recognize that the rules have changed, and you need to update your plan. "Fight fire with fire," as CA governor Gavin Newsom said (and is now doing with his state). [**Add your name: Don't let Republicans steal the House through redistricting. Tell Democrats to "fight fire with fire"**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td67900ef-ce3c-47b6-a584-6c8b106012a6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
