# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/203?t=1&akid=566%2E181023%2EDZTofZ)
Hi there, growing up, my parents taught me that everyone deserves a fair shot in life.
As special education teachers, they took me to work with them, and I got to see firsthand how hard they fought for their students to be treated fairly. From long nights writing IEPs to preparing classes on the weekend, they worked hard to ensure all kids could have access to a quality education.
Through their work, my parents instilled in me the importance of service. They taught me we all do better when we all do better. **And that if you see a wrong, it’s your job to try to make it right.**
[](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/239?c0=jmb-em-q32025.A5XsW4&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20250731_AM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=566%2E181023%2EDZTofZ)
I’ve carried those lessons with me every step of my life — from my time working in civil rights, to leading Wayne State Law School, to serving as Secretary of State. I’ve never given up the fight to ensure everyone has a fair chance to thrive.
**I’m running for Governor of Michigan to continue that work and make sure that every Michigan family has that fair shot.**
[**If you’re with me, can you pitch in a donation to my campaign right now, ahead of our upcoming end-of-month fundraising deadline? Anything you can give makes a difference.**](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/854?c0=jmb-em-q32025.OcO0Lx&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20250731_AM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=566%2E181023%2EDZTofZ)
I’ve investigated radical extremist groups, taught civil rights and voting rights law, and I ran for Secretary of State to make sure our government is efficient and transparent, that every voice is heard, and that every legitimate vote is counted.
Some people didn’t like that very much — but I’ve never backed down from a tough fight. I’ve spent my life standing up to powerful interests, and I’ll keep standing up to any bullies or billionaires who try to deceive us, divide us, take away our rights, or deprive us of our opportunities.
**Now, I’m fighting to make Michigan the best place to be a kid, raise a kid, stay, and call home.** To do that, we need transparent leadership, safe schools and neighborhoods, and good education and childcare. Every Michigander should be able to pay their bills, put food on the table, and take care of their families.
[**That’s what I’m ready to fight for as Michigan’s next Governor. Will you join me by donating before our midnight deadline?**](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/854?c0=jmb-em-q32025.OcO0Lx&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20250731_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=566%2E181023%2EDZTofZ)

This first-of-its-kind facility will provide access to healthy, affordable food, family health services, education advancement, career opportunities, financial services, and other resources. | | VPFF ENDORSE DEL. RASOUL FOR RE-ELECTION Virginia Professional Fire Fighters put their lives on the line every day to protect our Commonwealth, and I am humbled to have their endorsement for my re-election in this contested race. Over the years, we have fought together to expand benefits, improve safety measures, and strengthen their workforce. I will continue to fight for our firefighters in Richmond. | | | | 2025 ELECTION | Don't get complacent, come out and canvass! Thank you so much for all of your help and support. Let's win this thing! | | | MEET THE CANDIDATES! | | | | ANDREW PAYTON FOR HD-34 Andrew Payton has spent years fighting for progress in Harrisonburg—whether it's pushing for bold climate action, expanding access to education, or advocating for working families. Friend - I wish I were reaching out today with better news. _I know you don 't hear from me often, so please know that when I make a plea like this, it really is necessary._ The super PAC that pledged to spend their entire war chest to defeat me just spent _**$1 MILLION**_ on a MEGA ad buy to crush my re-election campaign. ...from Big Pharma, the fossil fuel industry, and the mega-donors who put profit over people. And I’m damn proud of it!
And now, we’re up against our first campaign fundraising deadline since Donald Trump and the Republicans gutted Medicaid to bankroll those same power players. If you’re ready to put money where the fight is, chip in today—because they’ve got deep pockets, but we’ve got determination. When I decided to run for Congress, I knew I wouldn’t accept a cent from Big Pharma or Big Oil...That’s why this campaign counts on grassroots supporters—people like you, our neighbors, our community. And it’s your support that keeps us moving forward. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-25q3?refcode=x_250731_Zilch_EOM1_act]
Here’s what that fight looks like:
I’m taking on Big Pharma by working to ban their direct-to-consumer advertising, which they use to justify jacking up the prices of medication. These ads are a billion-dollar industry for pharmaceutical companies, and much of their profits go toward promotion. This ban would help ensure medical decisions are made between patients and their doctors based on what works, not on who spends the most on advertising.
I’m standing up to Trump’s cruel deportation policies by demanding due process for Oregon families taken by ICE and CBP. When officials kidnapped Kilmar Abrego Garcia, I flew to El Salvador to demand his due process rights. I co-sponsored legislation to expand health coverage for families regardless of immigration status, and I pushed to block federal funds from going to Trump’s cruel ICE quotas.
I’m leading the charge for universal, accessible health care—including the right to abortion. While Donald Trump and his allies just pushed through the biggest Medicaid cut in history, I co-sponsored a bill to let states build and fund their own universal health care systems. And I co-sponsored another bill to stop states from blocking people who travel to access abortion care—because my daughter shouldn’t have fewer rights than her grandmother did.
Here’s the truth: we brought in nothing from the industries ripping off our communities because that’s exactly how I want it. But if we’re going to keep taking on these power players and winning, we need you in our corner.
This campaign runs on people power, not corporate cash. Chip in before tonight at midnight and show them that real change comes from the ground up. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-25q3?refcode=x_250731_Zilch_EOM1_act]

Maxine

This week’s _Hold the Line_ Podcast features my address to Canada—a response to what we experienced on the first leg of the Canadian tour, and what government officials and Believers can expect moving forward. We spent a week worshiping across the nation, facing _much_ controversy and _many_ obstacles. All the hate we received only served to shine a greater spotlight on the move of the Gospel happening in Canada! subject: What a kick-off!
body:
We welcomed supporters from all across Michigan yesterday

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ba47424776de/breaking-news-citizens-only-voting-amendment-submitted-to-board-of-canvassers-8370941?e=ecf60db114)

| | | | | [DONATE TODAY](https://vote.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=12ae025e5876fdceb812e1ab0&id=5ee6f5a47e&e=ecf60db114)
---
|
---
| **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
**July 31, 2025**
**Momentum Builds as Citizen Only Voting Campaign Launches in Michigan**
**Bloomfield Township, MI** — With high energy and a strong wave of grassroots enthusiasm, the movement to protect Michigan’s elections launched this week with a powerful press conference at the Oakland County Republican Party Headquarters.
Hosted by Americans for Citizen Voting – Michigan, Wednesday marked the official kickoff of a statewide petition drive to place a Citizen Only Voting Amendment on the 2026 ballot.
The room was packed with citizens, elected officials, and party leaders who came together around one core belief: Only U.S. citizens should be allowed to vote in Michigan elections. The event signaled not just the beginning of a campaign, but the rise of a growing movement determined to restore confidence in the electoral process.
Sen. Ruth Johnson, a prominent face of the effort, emphasized the significance of the measure, “This is a really important day for election integrity in Michigan. 14 other states have already adopted a Constitutional Amendment like this, and we need to join them. The use of photo ID and verification of citizenship for voting are common sense safeguards that have broad bipartisan support across the board.”
“Today was more than a launch—it was a statement,” said Kurt O’Keefe, Treasurer for Americans for Citizen Voting – Michigan. “The people of Michigan are ready to take a stand and say clearly that our elections should be decided by Americans, and only Americans.”
Supporters left the event energized and equipped with petitions, ready to help gather the nearly half a million signatures required to place the amendment on the ballot. Volunteers are now mobilizing across the state, bringing the campaign into neighborhoods, churches, small towns, and city centers.
“This is a grassroots movement in every sense of the word,” said Michigan Republican Party Chairman Jim Runestad. “Michiganders from all walks of life are stepping up because they believe in fair, secure elections. This amendment isn’t about politics—it’s about principle.”
The proposed amendment would require the Secretary of State to verify the citizenship of all voters, regularly review the voter rolls, and implement voter ID—while ensuring fairness through free state-issued IDs for those facing hardship. It’s a clear and constitutional way to protect the value of every lawful vote.
“We had people drive in from hours away just to be here,” said Vance Patrick, Oakland County GOP Chair. “That kind of commitment shows just how deeply people care about this cause—and how ready they are to take action.”
“This effort is bringing people together—Republicans, Independents, and Democrats, too” said Paul Jacob, Chairman of Americans for Citizen Voting.“Election integrity is not a partisan issue. It’s about preserving the foundation of our republic. We’ve seen efforts across the country to dilute voter eligibility. Here in Michigan, we’re drawing the line and saying: only citizens vote here.”
This campaign is just getting started—and the momentum is undeniable.
**Want to get involved?**
Visit [**ONLYCITIZENS.VOTE/MICHIGAN**](https://vote.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=12ae025e5876fdceb812e1ab0&id=d72eb35f16&e=ecf60db114) to **volunteer, donate,** or learn more.
📩 **Media inquiries:** info@onlycitizens.vote

---
|
---
| **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** July 31st, 2025Contact: nathan@nathanmagsig.com
---
| | | | | **Magsig Reports Half a Million Dollars Raised for State Senate Race**
**(Clovis, CA)** \- Today, Nathan Magsig announced an impressive fundraising report, with $500,000 raised in the first half of 2025. The total reflects hundreds of individual contributions from supporters across the Central Valley.
_“I am deeply honored to have such incredible support in my run for State Senate,”_ said Magsig. _“This report is a testament to the trust and shared belief in our vision for California. It’s not just about me—it’s about the hundreds of volunteers, supporters, and donors who believe we can make a difference. We’ve shown what’s possible with common-sense leadership at the local level, and now it’s time to bring that same focus to Sacramento.”_
As a Fresno County Supervisor, Magsig has built a strong record of delivering results: expanding housing, cutting red tape, lowering costs, and championing responsible forest management. His first fundraising report demonstrates not only strong momentum for his State Senate campaign, but also the Valley’s trust in his ability to fight for more energy production, practical solutions, and reduced government waste in Sacramento.
---
| ###
Nathan Magsig is a current Fresno County Supervisor, former Mayor of Clovis, and is running for the 12th Senate District. His family, wife Julie and their three children, reside in Clovis, CA.

| **JOIN NANCY MACE IN MYRTLE BEACH

You’re invited to the “Mother of All Town Halls” Event!**
Nancy Mace is bringing her “Mother of All Town Halls” to Veterans Cafe & Grill in Myrtle Beach on Wednesday, August 6th. Amplifying her statewide effort to speak directly with voters, take questions, and share her bold vision for South Carolina. I’ve always fought for what’s right, even when it wasn’t easy. Doing what’s right often means doing what is hard. Whether it was breaking barriers as the first female graduate of The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets, or standing up in Washington for lowering taxes, protecting women and children and bringing back law and order. I’ve done it for one reason: because I love South Carolina. But now, our state is at a crossroads. South Carolina continues to face the same challenges as we have for decades. And we ask ourselves, to what end? High taxes, turning a blind eye to sanctuary policies, allowing illegals to run wild in our state, few prosecutions if any, nearly last in the nation in education and the indoctrination of mentally ill ideology into our schools at every level. All paid for by hard working South Carolinians.

clean_body: I’m running for the Senate against a politician who, while our streets burned, pushed lawsuits against law enforcement officials | Fellow Conservative, My name is Adam Schwarze, and I’m a former Navy SEAL, Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan running for U.S. Senate against Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor—a politician even more radical than her boss. I’m requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota. I hold a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations. I’m starting this race with absolutely nothing , but because of the enormity of the race's outcome, I figured there is no harm in asking for your help. At the end of the day, my request of you will end in one of two ways: 1.) . 2.) you read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am. I’m not a career politician. I’m a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation’s call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war. Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, defunded our police , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe. This isn’t the Minnesota I grew up in—or the one any Minnesotan deserves. If you are reading this email right now and you don’t live in Minnesota, then I’m sure you’ll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today—individuals of integrity. That’s not who my opponent is. We have an incredible opportunity to elect a Republican to the U.S. Senate next year - something voters in this state haven’t done since they re-elected former Senator Norm Coleman in 2002. As a Republican, I know the odds are tough in a state that hasn’t voted red in a presidential election since 1976. But as a former Navy SEAL, I thrive in tough fights. I’ve faced worse odds overseas and am ready to bring that same grit to Washington. Here’s what I stand for: Restoring law and order by supporting our police and cracking down on crime. Cutting taxes and regulations to ease the burden on retirees and small businesses. Securing our borders to protect our communities and sovereignty. Defending our Second Amendment rights and traditional values. Stopping the radical left’s agenda that’s eroding the America we love. You don’t know me, but you know what men like me stand for and our reputation. So, . This race won’t be easy. The Democrats have deep pockets, and the radical left will stop at nothing to keep this seat. I’m running to serve you, to protect our way of life, and to ensure Minnesota remains a place where faith, family, and freedom thrive. I hope you’ll invest in me right now – any amount will help. With gratitude, Adam Schwarze Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate - Minnesota FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA** | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/akzsbuznh9PwliMXaNgUUicpO72mwP6HuwkH1ABraP8AhkjOYNuQ6p0zK_yMniEsgapJAZuMaEogU_0wnTQNeSbmX4EUWfUtpJpLSsMSxAxMBzwYbM0gcNVvPQVux2x4zUirLtAFXfqBvRL8HQDYZQP2w3u0JPzWN4T-6XIld_GYi8-zlhWTSGCqWYfYor-nSGzD4rBWwB1-UPfvkErr6cNmxZJaNk2SGhPhknfBbJhAaE6eQYH_gQPei_Ubit7IEjnya5m3iP-i37tXXMF5tMS8E8ARUZVGVUoakSbNm57yt7lRrD0SlJZovvqdJ4Prr4_9I-GhGOKkogB3FdXjKonM6gZfKWZwEzS3WrQWgWabpbimm948_uJ6e95F-YgrZ9sbIPBCu2ZlT5dEu6cjPfVubP8YE-oASFdTmwx1rYKKFOoa01bpEWjnwpw2n7l7M7qTUIOwfzD50LsA6VTANFHV2m4Uu3WLkBNEdiN9uUMUuNcTTHYK_S84cGI7tRsi-AOIRkwMqRNe3-zbLyhRvVl3M-pR6gQkpPVPFaeU9IHp0MFZ9GFAyGw_fhcoDUvMTykIPjyv5DUmctgF1IIYRSQg4boXircVeqyvaO9yhEOTjpFBdDCylEWyCFigViqOnJE5F5jKLDXdYW1N9xCgJiGBqmLGeh7IyG-dIunkWvEhoE2zbOL0rL98Y2G1OQxkPWbg1Fb5jQVlg8m-8rDRXJRh00VYIf7iNQ/MytYSfkKByefSOW45hI7GBqWyObCNnnB/11) [NO](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/1sSDQXAPNhbwhlYx_qDAn2u3IYGpB97uyxr9tpsigBmo_AG4SuJOWeVfErp3IZ9Ga00GN1--_Wglt_qTX65XLxhFpzo1964Il1stlcSGmFrjvS6G8vpBOn-xvXkOW5ehAyS-3RMmMGBVjWUmuVDIN6kdggvX8TWjzv3Or9jWaUadvmvoIf7enfZd797MbqRVk3TrVuyIsHtgqtXcDBaTTEWF0g-oB4wIwmyUYOiAJICNV3wVxr0TxppGS4ZsTPom4OD_M64FPjCcQcNu8WYbO6Y6CPOq_ArQrIcTvEBMSgVLJ8Dsp1SzmJHBwjVlTqCT0hHdGXoVgOuxNl5cGW0GVCchqriUem-3LZA0_BegWn5imUOp9YZjzgrYrTHe_vjNShU8Qf7joqr4YAh4KFdFhtSToFsntGgialLI6srNhIeycxOOMFMF091TaokMOTJoxtb6Y_NqZrKO8vRekHOMAFVSLkJ-EoawmZa0-Gwb81nnAlGYZKroZJOFamtP_QNqtr6dR0eDHVzPmF4UR_P1H6XEsfc9hjNjTOaFwrTFyOrZqjbktFt__7Gc6gxB-ABVoOVJq_EV-y2uqPFXDiTQSI2RMTPzYfUw9GF6Sqh-Kn544mgqn5Db9bcOcmw8zWQIqgt9YAkn25QEjjL3LD3J3PvlFHyNhFZqiiCIgxn1b60L2pyMNt1Fg2P9-GgySExcdmwJtfWHCe0LKGL_faRAOcdGA8Kl5vcTSA/OlHM_1OaTdi6pvT16K9hpnpnHC8LSjaA/11) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you today...

_What is your opinion about the Supreme Court 's role in our constitutional republic? _

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

Dear Peter,
On Tuesday, we held the official launch of my campaign for Johnson County Commission Chair - and **WOW** , what a night it was!
The room was PACKED with friends, family, neighbors, and supporters from every corner of our community. The energy was electric, and the message was clear:
**Johnson County is ready for new leadership — leadership that listens, leads with common sense, and puts taxpayers first.**
I’m incredibly grateful to everyone who showed up, signed up, and stepped up. Your enthusiasm has ignited this campaign with real momentum.
But the work is just beginning.
If you believe in responsible budgeting, transparency in government, and a commission that puts people before politics — I need you on #teamKAREN.
**If you haven't already, please consider chipping in today to help us maintain this momentum.** _**Remember — I’m running this campaign as a businesswoman, not a career politician. Every dollar will be spent strategically and with purpose. When you contribute, you're not just donating — you're making a smart investment in real, results-driven leadership.**_

With gratitude,
**Karen Crnkovich**

body:
Trump’s order is the culmination of years of attacks on absentee ballots and vote-by-mail. In the months before the 2020 election, Trump repeatedly spread disinformation and conspiracy theories about the legitimacy of mail-in ballots as he campaigned for reelection. With MAGA angling for total control, Trump wants to end their use forever.
RUSH $25 or more right now to help us defend the use of mail-in ballots across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073125_2&amount=25]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073125_2&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail.
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs Attorney General Pam Bondi to “take all necessary action” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We've got to keep fighting and work to protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $25 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073125_2&amount=25]

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure, mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”
Opponents of voting rights have proven they'll go to any length necessary to stop people from voting and make sure that they stay in power. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

subject: I’m officially in the race for U.S. Senate
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-cooper?refcode=072725_4 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-cooper?refcode=072725_4]
Hi, Peter,
I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. I’ve had enough.
We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and The Real Texas PAC to get us started off strong? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-cooper?refcode=072725_4]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-cooper?refcode=072725_4]
These are no ordinary times, Peter . I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong. Something has to give.
There’s another path, Peter. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
Washington can look like this, too. It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you, Peter .
We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have The Real Texas's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. Please give whatever is right for you and split a donation between our team and The Real Texas today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-georgia?refcode=072725_4]

My friends,
This campaign for governor has always been about California’s future – tackling rising costs, defending our freedoms, and standing up for communities too often left behind.
Vice President Harris has made her decision not to run, and I thank her for her decades of service to our state and country. As her friend, I’m profoundly grateful for all she has done and will continue to do to lift up Californians and all Americans.
My mission hasn’t changed. This is a campaign built to lead, built to win, and built to fight for every Californian, in every zip code.
Our path to victory is clear. I’m ready to lead on day one as Governor of California.
And today, I’m ready to win.
If you’re with me, I’m asking you to join my campaign with a contribution right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tagov-em]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tagov-em]
I’ve spent my career working for the people of California – to make life better, more just, and more equitable.
I believe deeply in making sure the California dream is within reach for all those who seek it, and continuing our state’s role as a beacon of hope for so many.
Washington Republicans are working overtime to roll back our rights and create fear and uncertainty in our communities – but I’ve been through these fights before.
During the last Trump administration, I led efforts to protect reproductive rights, defend vulnerable communities, and expand access to health care – no matter what was happening in Washington.
I’m ready to lead again – and I need your help to continue building momentum.
Will you chip in today to power the work ahead? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tagov-em]

body:
Peter,

Planned Parenthood is an essential healthcare provider that thousands of Minnesotans rely on for cancer screenings, family planning services, STI testing, abortion care, and more. For many of them, it’s their only source of care.

And yet, the Trump administration is trying to defund Planned Parenthood. Make no mistake: this will hurt the people of Minnesota—especially women, the LGBTQ+ community, and low-income folks.

If Trump and his cronies succeed, at least 200 health centers will be threatened and over 1.1 million people could lose access to the care they need.

That’s why I joined a coalition of 22 states and Washington, D.C. to take the Trump administration to court. I’m fighting to prevent these harmful cuts and protect the health and wellbeing of Minnesotans.

Derek, We’re about to ask you to donate directly to the DNC ahead of our upcoming end-of-month fundraising deadline to help us keep building a strong Democratic Party that will fight back against Trump and his extreme billionaire allies. If that’s all you need to hear, you can use this link to pitch in: [**https://democrats.org/go/July**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-2025?amount=3&refcode=em_20250731_4135_fr&refcode2=4135_22930333_vpVaqg&akid=4135%2E22930333%2EvpVaqg) If you need more information, we hope you’ll give us a chance to explain why your support matters so much right now: With the help of our grassroots supporters, we’ve been able to:

Peter,

I know I keep saying that Republicans' Big, Ugly Bill (which just became law) is the worst betrayal of working families in U.S. history. But unfortunately, it's true.
* **15 million Americans will lose their healthcare** thanks to Trump’s Medicaid cuts, sabotage of the Affordable Care Act, and refusal to renew health care tax credits.
* **The largest cuts to SNAP ever,** ripping food away from millions of Americans while raising grocery costs.
* **Putting rural hospitals at risk of shutting down,** cutting off health care access in Central and Eastern Washington.
* **Defunding Planned Parenthood** , jeopardizing preventative care like cancer screenings, birth control, and STI testing.
* **Raising energy costs for families and businesses** by gutting both clean energy tax credits and other investments in our local economy.

All that, and much more, Peter – and it's just to give billionaires and giant corporations trillions in tax breaks. The Republican Party has facilitated the biggest transfer of wealth ever. But don't let them fool you into thinking they are modern day Robin Hoods.
**They are taking from the poorest folks among us to put handfuls of cash into the pockets of the people who need extra handouts _the least_** – and it's Washington families, seniors, workers, and women who will pay the price.
That's why I'm not giving up this fight. I can't –**so I'm working around the clock to hold them accountable and to make sure that people in Washington state and everyone knows **_exactly_**who's to blame when our rural hospitals close, when health insurers drop our kids from coverage, and when nursing homes kick seniors out.**
It's going to take all of us together to get our nation back on its feet. **[That's why, if you're able, I hope you'll chip in $5 or whatever you can spare today to help us keep organizing, supporting our neighbors, and defending Washington's values in Congress.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112507390/560712106/-145648726?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk528-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDZkYTE3My0zZTZlLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7ToSLSHYPFqhjub2JlFffVPANu_7SUxW70x6eZRbBXg=)**
Grateful to be in this fight with you,
Patty Murray

**The far-Left wants the current administration to obey the dictates of federal district court judges rather than the will of a majority of the American people.**

body:
Here's what's happening in the Forward world...

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=1)
---
Thursday, July 31, 2025 | Peter -- We celebrated our third birthday this week in _**style**_ _!_ Tuesday night we had a giant virtual event with Forward leaders and supporters from across the nation. Hundreds of you turned out to celebrate, fundraise, and build a better party and we couldn't be more proud to stand next to you on this path. Click the image below to watch the hype video we put together from the past few years of growth... _They Don't Party Like We Do._ [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEouH4SjeZmYtvTWulgNFAfbGPFI2B6R-fPZFR0doHszk&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=2) Together we raised a whopping $30,000 in an hour, all of which we're dedicating to helping build state parties across the country. If you want to give any more to help blow that number out of the water, we've got another $5,000 in matching funds since we beat our goal. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/forward_turns_3?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=3 "Celebrate Our Birthday Together!") [Chip In $33 For 3 Years Today!](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate_3year?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=4)
---
**[Lindsey Drath on Expanding the Two-Party Political System](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=6iERT1Nlll6fRjMoxjWR2xJL2HzcUOWgapdtsNr4nMMlWSksrOSGVcoQlNyCHfrj9OS-zFhX_IENy58w3CGBqdvO9eVeGlwOQ0EKuXZFfQGqkl_EAqX8Jvdz5nhcUCnymw53lpdKlnnaNnfB6yWvrYxjpy2lfK-a6giWHik5wcs&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=5)** | **C-SPAN** Forward Party CEO Lindsey Williams Drath joins C-SPAN to discuss all things Forward. She breaks down our growth in the last three years and the goals we're setting for the next three years. **[Could A Third Party Ever Be Viable IN American Politics?](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=RvmuK9_akypAjclIVyPol0HVNpC2pamqDa8pcSniuvoDuDb3qfD_g2-AFyJ_qWnvD7z7znzpd40Rc8AAFbfM6cbJC7X0lwvJh8Xk6HrFRi8kv81Sh7wiXT87NPgVMZxl&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=6)** | **WHYY** Hint: Yes! Listen in to hear exactly how third parties _are_ viable in our system and what it will take for us to get there. **[A Former EPA Administrator On The Future of The Agency](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=8c4KZMXYR5lO6Tv9ZXupeXRjERuJ1OtYAKJ2iBB7RzEFA7EzwrtkjX9jgnroYDGXy0rIkX4Igf71TaK2FR2Vx8uVwikUeffK7PuQrE-CfdSBw89yW1sZBZumdWkCQq1wdzOXx44-NBiKfzqhHjFLnw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=7)** | **NPR** Former EPA Administrator and New Jersey Governor Christine Todd Whitman, co-founder of the Forward Party, joins NPR's Michel Martin to discuss the state of the EPA and its future in this administration.
**July 31 | Waynesboro Regional Meetup
** Please join your fellow Forwardists for a meetup at Seven Arrows Brewing Company just west of Waynesboro on Thursday, July 31st. You can arrive from 6:00 pm onward. We will be getting to know one another and discussing volunteer opportunities, local interest in ranked-choice voting (RCV), membership in the Forward Party in Virginia, and organizing the Forward Party in the Waynesboro region and beyond. We look forward to seeing you there! **[Register →](https://home.forwardparty.com/waynesboro_regional_meetup?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=8)** **July 31 | Civic Engagement With The Young Forwardists
** Join the Young Forwardists team at 7:00 PM EST/4:00 PM PST for an exclusive Civic Engagement opportunity! As our political divisions continue to grow, it's up to every student at every high school and college to lead the charge toward change, starting with local ordinance and political engagement! This meeting will establish some ways that you can get involved locally, in your state, and nationally. **[Register →](https://home.forwardparty.com/civic_engagement_20250731?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=9)** **July 31 | Women's Committee Quarterly Meeting
** Whether you've been involved since the beginning or are just getting started, your voice and ideas are welcome. This is a space for collaboration, listening, and building together. We are hoping to get our friend Katie Usalis from Represent Women to join us and discuss the 2025 Gender Parity Report. After, Shelia Joneleit, Committee Chair, will discuss the Executive Team's recent planning session on gender parity. Executive Team Member Jennifer Cheung will then unveil an exciting **new leadership initiative for ForwardWomen!** **[Register →](https://home.forwardparty.com/wc3rdqmeeting?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=10)** **August 6 | ¡Adelante Juntos! Shaping the Future of the FWD Party Hispanic & Latino Committee
** Acompáñanos en la primera reunión del Comité Hispano y Latino del Partido Forward mientras nos unimos para dar forma a nuestra visión colectiva. Join us for the very first meeting of the Forward Party’s Hispanic & Latino Committee as we come together to shape our collective vision. This conversation is centered on listening to your ideas, your concerns, and your hopes for how this committee can support, elevate, and engage our community. Whether you're new to the Forward movement or already deeply involved, your voice matters. Help us lay the foundation for a committee that reflects and represents the full diversity of the Hispanic and Latino experience. Let’s build it together. **[Register →](https://home.forwardparty.com/_adelante_juntos_shaping_the_future_of_the_fwd_hispanic_latino_committee?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=11)** **August 13 | MA FWD Boston Meet Up
** Welcome Forwardists! Join us at Grafton Street Pub & Grill for happy hour on the 13th of August. Meet fellow Forwardists, learn about the movement in the state, get more deeply involved, and share a drink with new friends! Parties are built in person, no matter how convenient zoom is. We can't wait to see you there. **[Register →](https://home.forwardparty.com/forward_massachusetts_august_2025_boston_meet_up?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=12)**
**ICYMI - ****[The Forward Party adds Goodwin, Berube in Senior Positions as Third Party Movement Grows](https://www.forwardparty.com/media/blog/the-forward-party-adds-goodwin-berube-in-senior-positions-as-third-party-movement-grows/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=13)** | **Forwardparty.com** **[Independents Should Embrace The Moment And Lean Into Their Power](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=dVV2rW1vUlrpxgYY_oyMKhSpjMDDSlO_sUv3Kymh7cf_eIHSmoaDwE12joBKJ7xu8Kh2KYj_wI3UblDOYEGxYod640n4cRDWVgAOGxbjsgfhXyKUf2ujyd5DhxK3YRK4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=14)** | **The Hill**
[ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=HN-VuZ6-MtyTZDOwpLeQohBI2w5n1fstLPCAOB1eS8pn49pgKy1KM2eEYboZkJaE&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=15) [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=HR9MoATtHgNjF_4kmlo5pN8R4zJ-fGDLgTAMST8PY6mgKwzOK4bTDEpy9KU5BOzg&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=16) [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=C67zBN9acu3ZSVmLPV47peHvpkNPm4HcBUGM4-0XJTPgmEVLc_dN12xbGWLIkZIR&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=17) [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=KO8ZOB0mq2gq63DvFrKfe08uhOv-byHfKpIIFrTtOpPikh4D0waR8pVrn6wFcdzO&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=18) [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEuogCR1FcLzdL_LSGKjfikF5BT1dZn3HN2gM4OEGEI0z&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_73&n=19) Copyright © 2025 Forward Party, all rights reserved. Friend, July was a big month for our campaign.
First: We started this month by writing in the Daily Kos about how Kevin Kiley is a shameless and spineless rubber-stamper for Donald Trump— voting to pass his devastating budget that will steal food from families in our district and take away their healthcare.
Then: Just after we received a poll that put us ahead of Kiley in this race, we earned the endorsement and support of Congressman Jared Huffman. Analysis already showed this seat is one of the most flippable in Congress, but with the momentum that we gained, it's even closer.
Now: With just 12 hours until our midnight Deadline, we need your help to reach our End of Month Fundraising Goal. These goals are what will set our campaign up for success down the road, and we create them with this in mind.

Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.
After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
Vice President Harris is staying out of this race. Now what?
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39947%2E3422442%2EGnoAhP)
Dear Peter,
Yesterday, Vice President Harris announced that she would not be running for California Governor.
**[I want to talk a little bit about what this is going to mean for us, but first, will you chip in $5 to show everyone watching this race that our campaign is as strong as ever?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250731_2_ak?refcode=em20250731-39947&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39947_3422442_GnoAhP&akid=39947%2E3422442%2EGnoAhP)**
Many Californians, including myself, appreciate Kamala’s long history of dedication and service to our state. Now that she’s made clear that she’s staying out, the race for California Governor is going to kick into higher gear.
You can expect to see new polls in the weeks and months to come, and a bunch of political donors and organizations that have been waiting to see what happens will be getting off the sidelines.
**In terms of how I’m spending my time, I’m going to keep doing what I’ve been doing for the past five months, which is getting into every part and pocket of California and meeting people where they are.** To represent a big state like California, I couldn’t wait to hear people’s stories and bring people together to work on solutions for our biggest challenges.
But on the money side, the reality is that winning elections here is expensive, and outside groups are going to be making decisions very soon about whether to flood money into this race.
**For a campaign like ours that rejects money from corporations, lobbyists, and executives at Big Pharma, Big Oil, and Big Banks, this is a make or break moment.** We’re counting on grassroots donors like you to help us show everyone that our campaign is strong and not going anywhere.
**[If you’ve been on the fence yourself about whether to give to our campaign, I’m telling you now: your donation today can really make an outsized difference. So please, will you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250731_2_ak?refcode=em20250731-39947&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39947_3422442_GnoAhP&akid=39947%2E3422442%2EGnoAhP)**

Thanks,
Katie

Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4g-em-footer?refcode=em20250731-39947&amounts=&t=3&refcode2=39947_3422442_GnoAhP&akid=39947%2E3422442%2EGnoAhP)**

clean_body: You don’t know me, but you know what men like me stand for and our reputation | Peter, My name is Adam Schwarze, and I’m a former Navy SEAL, Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan running for U.S. Senate against Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor—a politician even more radical than her boss. I’m requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota. I hold a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations. I’m starting this race with absolutely nothing , but because of the enormity of the race's outcome, I figured there is no harm in asking for your help. At the end of the day, my request of you will end in one of two ways: 1.) . 2.) you read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am. I’m not a career politician. I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war. Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, defunded our police , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe. This isn’t the Minnesota I grew up in—or the one any Minnesotan deserves. If you are reading this email right now and you don’t live in Minnesota, then I’m sure you’ll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today—individuals of integrity. Cutting taxes and regulations to ease the burden on retirees and small businesses. Securing our borders to protect our communities and sovereignty. Defending our Second Amendment rights and traditional values. Stopping the radical left’s agenda that’s eroding the America we love. You don’t know me, but you know what men like me stand for and our reputation. So, . This race won’t be easy. I’m running to serve you, to protect our way of life, and to ensure Minnesota remains a place where faith, family, and freedom thrive. I hope you’ll invest in me right now – any amount will help. body:
Recent data confirms that our communities are facing unprecedented challenges steeped in abuse and neglect. | | | Peter, TIME reports that ICE is kidnapping our loved ones at a higher rate than ever before. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/31/2025
body:
The state’s mandates, your money—and why counties are saying “Enough”
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
🎙️ Check out today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Denver’s progressive agenda is facing a [$200 million deficit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), triggering layoffs of up to 800 city workers. Critics warn Colorado’s [lawsuit-heavy legal climate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is pushing employers out, while public backlash is growing over plans to [reintroduce wolverines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) near Aspen. Colorado Springs is also struggling with a [52% spike in homelessness](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and Denver’s new [$950 million bond package](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) slashes funding for affordable housing while boosting cultural and road projects.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** The Trump administration announced two major shifts: repealing Obama-era EPA “endangerment findings” that triggered [$1 trillion in climate regulations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and issuing new protections for [religious expression in federal workplaces](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—both part of a broader push to restore constitutional freedoms.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Cory Gaines exposes how[ geothermal subsidies shift](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) costs to taxpayers in a classic wealth transfer, while Russ Minary urges a [revival of humor in politics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to disarm opponents with wit, not outrage. Meanwhile, Mesa County Commissioner Bobbie Daniel calls out [costly state mandates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and urges counties to demand local control and fiscal sanity.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, July 31, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Daniel: The state’s mandates, your money—and why counties are saying “Enough”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY BOBBIE DANIEL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Imagine walking into a restaurant, and before you even look at the menu, someone else orders for the whole table. They choose the most expensive items, add dessert, and go for top-shelf drinks—and when the check comes, they quietly slide it over to you. That, in a nutshell, is what the State of Colorado is doing to counties._
_Every year, new laws and regulations roll out of the Capitol with noble names and lofty goals. But when it comes time to pay for them, the state shrugs and walks away—leaving counties, and local taxpayers, to foot the bill. It’s called an unfunded mandate, and it’s become one of the biggest threats to responsible government in Colorado._
_In Mesa County, we’ve always believed in balancing our books and protecting the taxpayer. We’ve rebuilt reserves, cut waste, and returned tens of millions of dollars back to the people under TABOR. Just last year, we lowered our mill levy when property taxes soared—because when families are tightening their belts, government should too._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Gaines: Subsidies save some—but in reality, they’re just wealth transfers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* While state officials tout geothermal as a “low-cost” clean energy solution, Gaines argues it's only affordable for those whose projects are heavily subsidized by taxpayers.
* He criticizes Colorado’s broader policy trend of redistributing wealth through subsidies in energy, transportation, and healthcare, claiming it unfairly burdens many to benefit a few.
* Gaines challenges the claim that geothermal is cost-effective on its own, asserting that if it truly were, private companies would have already adopted it without government intervention.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[‘Lawsuit inferno’: Tort reform advocate warns Colorado’s legal climate is driving out job creators](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The American Tort Reform Association labeled Colorado a “lawsuit inferno” in its 2025 report, citing 45 bills introduced—and more than half passed—that expanded civil liability or created new private rights of action.
* Critics argue the surge in liability-expanding laws is making Colorado increasingly hostile to businesses, nonprofits, and job creators, contributing to economic strain and uncertainty.
* Supporters of the new laws, like Democrat Rep. Steven Woodrow, say they help injured parties seek justice, while opponents, including Republican leadership, warn the laws send a damaging message to employers across the state.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Minary: Humor is good—even and especially in politics and culture](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY RUSS MINARY****| COMMENTARY | JULY 29** _This article is a departure from the usual banter on politics, religion, morality and taxes. We can all use a good laugh now and again. Monty Python was a British comedy troupe that did out of the box, thought-provoking, bawdy, irreverent skits on a variety of topics including politics and religion. That show has aged very well._
__

**[Tristan: How Trump’s second term is making history—promises made, promises kept](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY GEORGE TRISTAN | COMMENTARY | JULY 29** _It’s often said that elections have consequences; I submit this assertion expresses an undeniable truth that nearly all would attest to, regardless of one’s political persuasion. That said, how should the first six months of President Trump’s administration be objectively characterized?_
__

**[Colorado’s Medicaid growth is colliding with fiscal reality](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | NATIONAL | JULY 29** _A new report from the Common Sense Institute (CSI) warns that Colorado’s Medicaid program is on an unsustainable path—driven by rapid expansion at the state level and compounded by shrinking federal support. The warning comes as lawmakers prepare for a possible special session to address the state’s growing budget deficit._

subject: Canary in the coal mine
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
What we’re seeing from Republican leadership right now isn’t just corruption — it’s a warning shot to the rest of the world. Peter, let’s not sugarcoat it:

What we’re seeing from Republican leadership right now isn’t just corruption — it’s the canary in the coal mine to the rest of the world.

When the Speaker of the House kills a vote to keep Donald Trump’s name out of the Epstein files, when Trump calls on Texas to redraw its maps to guarantee a win for his party and when extreme Republicans throw out the rules, rewrite the laws, and protect the powerful at any cost — we're showing the world exactly what happens when democracy is for sale.

We’re telling everyday Americans, including all of us here in Missouri, that if you’ve got enough money, power, connections, and yes-men in your back pocket, you can rewrite the rules for yourself while everyone and everything else takes a hit.

**But Peter, if I've learned anything throughout my career as a public defender, prosecutor, criminology professor, and now as your representative, it's that NO ONE should be above the law, not even the president.**

I've spent my entire career holding powerful people accountable, not because it’s easy, but because it’s right. I'm not here to protect the system, I'm here to fix it and build a democracy that works for everyone. But I can't fight this battle alone. If you can, please chip in $5 to ensure we don't fall short of our $16,500 end-of-month fundraising goal before midnight tonight → [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bell-2025-q3-email &refcode2=dpwillis67@gmail.com**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112510900/560724109/554393595?refcode=em25_250731_eom4_fndd_gq_act___WB_ettx&utm_campaign=em25_250731_eom4_fndd_gq_act___WB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=6d3af18c-466e-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmQzYWYxOGMtNDY2ZS1mMDExLThkYzktNjA0NWJkYTlkOTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=w3qrnBJyTx4tAhQMVvczSos8UfV8uyxZTRKSaFu_OLc=)

Let's be clear: This is not just about Trump, it’s about the next person who sees how easy it was for him to tear down the guardrails; it's about any selfish politician who wants to follow in his footsteps. The canary in the coal mine is singing, and our democracy is at stake. We're not going down without a fight.

With gratitude,

Wesley

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

July 31, 2025

**Governor candidate Dr. Scott Jensen has issued the pointed letter below to Governor Tim Walz, regarding the administration’s inadequate response to the ongoing health risks posed by Canadian wildfire smoke blanketing the state.

***

The Honorable Tim Walz
Governor of Minnesota
130 State Capitol
75 Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd.
St. Paul, MN 55155

**_Re: Failure to Address Health Risks from Canadian Wildfire Smoke and Haze_**

Governor Walz:

As a physician and an ex-Minnesota State Senator, I am dismayed by the absence of concerted efforts on your part to protect Minnesotans from the ongoing and potentially dangerous concentrations of smoke and haze resulting from forest fires to the north. Our state has been under challenging air quality standards for several weeks, and the health consequences to our residents - especially children, fragile seniors, asthma sufferers and those with ongoing respiratory or cardiovascular disease - mount daily.

Other than repeated and nebulous air quality warnings, your administration has offered little more than vague instructions about staying indoors and cautious travel. This is not an adequate response to a public health emergency that has now gone on for an extended period. The absence of a coordinated, statewide effort is not just disappointing; **_it threatens health and well-being, infrastructure stability, ongoing micro-economies, and exposes medical facilities to surging and unpredictable patient needs._**

Your administration's inaction on this problem does not make Minnesotans safer.
I am requesting that you:

1\. **_Implement a comprehensive smoke/haze response plan_** by contacting Canadian Government officials to obtain timeframe and details regarding their mitigation efforts and reporting findings to Minnesota residents, health care workers, and health care facilities.
2\. **_Provide ongoing public health recommendations_** to Minnesotans addressing actionable strategies for minimizing likelihood for exceeding exposure to established thresholds for dangerous particulate concentrations.
3\. **_Authorize and encourage pharmacies and health systems to provide emergency medication refills for patients with known respiratory ailments_** and to maintain adequate inventories of oxygen measurement devices, thermometers, respiratory OTC medicines, and oxygen supplies.
4\. **_Collaborate and coordinate with federal and Canadian partners_** to improve cross-border response efforts.
5\. **_Develop a long-term air quality emergency plan_** to avoid the recent too little/too late response.

Governor Walz, leadership is more than ‘checking the box’ by distributing a proclamation. It is data collection, action, coordination, and unwavering commitment to the well-being of all. I urge you to immediately take the above-mentioned steps to protect Minnesotans' health and well-being.

Sincerely,

Dr. Scott Jensen, Physician & Former Minnesota State Senator

clean_body: | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 31, 2025 Governor candidate Dr. Scott Jensen has issued the pointed letter below to Governor Tim Walz, regarding the administration’s inadequate response to the ongoing health risks posed by Canadian wildfire smoke blanketing the state. * The Honorable Tim Walz Governor of Minnesota 130 State Capitol 75 Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd. St. Paul, MN 55155 Re: Failure to Address Health Risks from Canadian Wildfire Smoke and Haze Governor Walz: As a physician and an ex-Minnesota State Senator, I am dismayed by the absence of concerted efforts on your part to protect Minnesotans from the ongoing and potentially dangerous concentrations of smoke and haze resulting from forest fires to the north. Our state has been under challenging air quality standards for several weeks, and the health consequences to our residents - especially children, fragile seniors, asthma sufferers and those with ongoing respiratory or cardiovascular disease - mount daily. Other than repeated and nebulous air quality warnings, your administration has offered little more than vague instructions about staying indoors and cautious travel. This is not an adequate response to a public health emergency that has now gone on for an extended period. The absence of a coordinated, statewide effort is not just disappointing; it threatens health and well-being, infrastructure stability, ongoing micro-economies, and exposes medical facilities to surging and unpredictable patient needs. Your administration's inaction on this problem does not make Minnesotans safer. I am requesting that you: 1\. Implement a comprehensive smoke/haze response plan by contacting Canadian Government officials to obtain timeframe and details regarding their mitigation efforts and reporting findings to Minnesota residents, health care workers, and health care facilities. 2\. Provide ongoing public health recommendations to Minnesotans addressing actionable strategies for minimizing likelihood for exceeding exposure to established thresholds for dangerous particulate concentrations. 3\. Authorize and encourage pharmacies and health systems to provide emergency medication refills for patients with known respiratory ailments and to maintain adequate inventories of oxygen measurement devices, thermometers, respiratory OTC medicines, and oxygen supplies. 4\. Collaborate and coordinate with federal and Canadian partners to improve cross-border response efforts. 5\. Develop a long-term air quality emergency plan to avoid the recent too little/too late response. Governor Walz, leadership is more than ‘checking the box’ by distributing a proclamation. It is data collection, action, coordination, and unwavering commitment to the well-being of all. I urge you to immediately take the above-mentioned steps to protect Minnesotans' health and well-being. Sincerely, Dr. Scott Jensen, Physician & Former Minnesota State Senator To Arrange an Interview with Scott Jensen Contact: Rita Hillmann Olson 952-491-0672 rita@drscottjensen.com Website: ** | Prepared and paid for by Dr. Scott Jensen for Governor | To unsubscribe, click .

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t0a67o&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1sdr8n29r50v55b90l5lsugw7c5dy7gpkxvvewt7n2yqi4zo4tgalaeowajecoev6e5atezufvuiry1muhbbibmn1nu74h2ia6rv88wut720eolnyoyz2bottwyqphrlo86uangvjm&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t0a67o&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t0a67o&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t0a67o&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t0a67o&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

name: Jon Ossoff
subject: When I first ran for Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
#

Peter, it’s the last night of July and we are just hours away from my end-of-month fundraising deadline.
I’m the only Democratic Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won in 2024. Several ultra-MAGA opponents have entered the race. And GOP-aligned Super PACs are already spending millions attacking me.
This is the fight ahead. And I need you by my side.
Before you turn in: **[Can you rush $5 before midnight to help me win in Georgia?**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-july25.vLE_dc&refcode=em250731-2-subs&t=1&akid=598%2E5691347%2E80pmij)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-july25.vLE_dc&refcode=em250731-2-subs&t=2&akid=598%2E5691347%2E80pmij)**
When I first ran for Senate five years ago, it was because I believed the election of someone so deeply unfit for the presidency posed a danger to the country.
Many people said it couldn’t be done. But you believed — not just in me, but that our Republic is worth defending, and Georgia could lead the way.
Then we won. Not just a Senate seat, but the Senate majority for Democrats.
Now Trump has launched a power grab unprecedented in our history, abusing his power and trying to poison our Republic with fear and intimidation.
Americans are now living in fear of their own government.
I’m fighting back, but I can’t do this alone.
I need you with me.
**[Please, if you can make it work, donate what you can before my midnight fundraising deadline.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-july25.vLE_dc&refcode=em250731-2-subs&t=3&akid=598%2E5691347%2E80pmij)

As always,
Jon Ossoff

subject: A majority of Democrats voted to block weapons sales to Israel
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last night, a new record high of 27 Democratic Senators voted in support
of Sen. Bernie Sanders’ bill to block more U.S. weapons sales to Israel.

For the first time, a majority of the Democratic caucus listened to the
American people and voted to stop using our tax dollars to sell more arms

This unprecedented mid-cycle redistricting is pouring gasoline on a fire that is already out of control - GERRYMANDERING. Except this is more than just gerrymandering, it’s redlining. A public hearing is scheduled for tomorrow at 10am. **Watch live at https://house.texas.gov/videos.**
And further more the president of the Heritage Foundation pushed the TN state legislature to [**de-charter Nashville**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=63c50e33d8&e=edbde6c9b1) , and take over the ‘blue’ city for not caving to Trump’s agenda.

And both parties use it as a tool. | | Dear Peter,
---
| | **Did you know **redwood trees grow faster when they’re rooted beside salmon-filled streams? When salmon return to redwood waterways to spawn and then die, their bodies help fertilize the towering trees with marine nutrients. In return, redwoods provide cool shade and clean water for young salmon. It’s an ancient and beautiful relationship. **That’s why we’re excited to share some good news:** The past two winters have brought strong salmon runs to Northern California. Hi Peter,
I wanted to reach out personally today to thank all of our campaign’s incredible grassroots supporters, and to let you know where things stand.
My team set a goal of raising $25,000 online by the end of July – that’s tonight at midnight. We’re less than $2,500 from our benchmark, and just a few more supporters chipping in will put us over the top.
Will you help us get there in these final hours before the deadline? Here’s a link to make a grassroots contribution: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cooke-q3-2025?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112516668/560743535/-2083379535?refcode=em-7.31.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZjZkNGM4NS01NDZlLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fL2XaCLwYuE_qa5fbqQp3g_bo-SBPzKYTUlpN7VUn9w=)**
Derrick Van Orden has shown that he isn’t interested in improving the lives of people in his district. In the past few months alone, he’s called for cutting veterans’ services, celebrated taking food resources away from hungry children, and taunted folks on social media after voting to cut healthcare access for thousands of people right here in WI-03.
Those are just three more reminders that we need more working class voices like ours in Congress who will fight like hell to build back the middle class.
I know you’re ready to bring the homegrown leadership we deserve to Congress, and that means hitting every target we set to have the strongest campaign possible. So if you can, will you consider contributing whatever you’re able to before midnight? Any amount will help us meet our goal and win back this swing seat. Thanks, Peter, and take care.
Becca

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Can I ask you something?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
We’ve got just a few hours until our end of month deadline at midnight tonight. That deadline comes at a moment unlike any other in our nation’s history.
#

Peter, we’ve got just a few hours until our end of month deadline at midnight tonight.
That deadline comes at a moment unlike any other in our nation’s history.
I served in Iraq as a Marine at the height of the war, about 20 years ago. All those years ago, I never thought I’d see the President of the United States blatantly ignore the Supreme Court. Never thought I’d see him turn the 250th anniversary of the creation of the U.S. Army into a birthday parade for himself — the kind of thing a dictator would do. I signed up to defend our Constitution. To make sure exactly that kind of thing never happened at home.
This is authoritarianism. It is here. And we need to stand up now or risk losing the rights and liberties we were born with.
You know what’s happening, but most people still don’t. If we’re going to build a movement that stops and reverses Trump’s power grab, we have to start reaching the people who aren’t reading the news every day.
That’s why I’m trying to meet and speak to people beyond just cable news. It’s why I’m doing podcasts and social media, interviews with local and national papers. It’s why I’m doing town halls in Arizona, Pennsylvania, Iowa, New Hampshire, and hopefully more soon.
That’s what I did in my campaign. It’s what I’ve been doing since I got elected. And I’m going to keep doing it as long as I have to until we start to break through to people.
[**To keep that going, I’m humbly asking you to chip in to my campaign. All I ask is whatever you can afford, even if it’s a donation as small as $1. Anything helps, truly. And it means the world to me to have your support.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july25.UmJNyp&refcode=em250731-2-160&t=1&akid=3930%2E734936%2EXxMC5G)

| | Disaster response is a life-or-death matter. But the current administration has stated its desire to eliminate FEMA as it exists and have states lead disaster response. States already lead disaster response; that is how disaster response works. Dismantling FEMA does not help with disaster response; it eliminates the safety net that serves as the backstop for emergency management. **434 members of the House agree that FEMA should not be eliminated – an outstanding majority.** [**Take a stand against the Trump Administration****and its****attempts to dismantle FEMA. Chip in $16 to take back the House so we can secure disaster relief and response for Northwest Washington.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112517451/560746224/1596212816?refcode=2025-07-31-eom&recurring=&amount=16&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=7f5b302e-576e-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjViMzAyZS01NzZlLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zECSuCtU9CrGDWWl8kTh_CJxRT-VYAcF_bUvDHK4mb4=) [Donate Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112517452/560746225/1596212816?refcode=2025-07-31-eom&recurring=&amount=16&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=7f5b302e-576e-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjViMzAyZS01NzZlLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zECSuCtU9CrGDWWl8kTh_CJxRT-VYAcF_bUvDHK4mb4=) Despite this bipartisan agreement, the Trump Administration has still taken steps to try to dismantle FEMA, such as:
* Allowing DOGE unlawful access to FEMA's systems, and directed FEMA to eliminate all climate change-related activities;
* Fired over 200 workers and pressured over 2,000 more to quit or accept early retirement packages;
* Cancelled FEMA's pre-disaster mitigation program; and
* Ended door-to-door canvassing to help survivors register for federal aid after disasters.

#

Peter, The demise of the Department of Justice isn’t slowing down — in fact, it’s accelerating. At Trump’s direction, in just six months, his former defense lawyers who run the Department have already:
* Dismissed criminal cases against Trump’s co-conspirators
* Fired J6 prosecutors and FBI agents
* Gutted the nonpartisan Public Integrity Section
* Pardoned donors and allies
* Opened criminal investigations against Trump’s dissenters and political opponents while closing investigations against allies
* Dismissed the indictment against Eric Adams in an effort to coerce political cooperation

And now, after promising full transparency for the Epstein files, Donald Trump is using the DOJ to protect himself. In May, I wrote a letter to AG Pam Bondi demanding to know if President Trump had instructed her to conceal the Epstein files to protect himself. **Now we know that is, in fact, exactly what is happening.** Rather than keep their repeated promise of full transparency, Trump and the DOJ are trying to gaslight the American people by seeking to have a court unseal grand jury testimony that would have nothing to do with Trump or others involved in Epstein’s child sex trafficking ring. And the Deputy Attorney General is defying proper DOJ procedures and protocols by personally meeting with Ghislaine Maxwell to fabricate new evidence in return for clemency — a truly disgusting and unethical use of the clemency power that would be criminal if not for Trump’s absolute immunity. **But neither of those categories of evidence includes the most relevant and important evidence that is redacted and ready to be released: witness interviews, recordings, texts, photos, and videos in particular.** Before running for Congress, I spent a decade as a federal prosecutor in the Southern District of New York, taking down violent gangs, organized crime bosses, and corporate fraudsters. **I know how the DOJ is supposed to work, and I know why this DOJ is doing permanent damage to our legal system.** That’s why I’ve taken matters into my own hands and called for Donald Trump, Pam Bondi, and Kash Patel to testify before Congress. I’ve moved to subpoena Bondi and Patel for their efforts to cover up Trump’s lawlessness and undermine the rule of law. And I’ve demanded a full release of the Epstein files.
