Hi there, I just got off the phone with my team, and I want to give you the same update they gave me: **We’re still 54 people short of hitting our 300-donor goal tonight.** [**_I’m going to ask you to be one of those final supporters we are counting on._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112517635/560746871/246949951?amount=5&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2025.07.31_Off-The-Phone_B1_F1_S1_C1_45AC_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNGIxNzg5OC01NzZlLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I2OC5HsAk4bw_XNUnwbS1xw6RlBPOtsxDC7z0i90TpE=) **But I want to explain why it’s so important that we hit this goal before midnight.** Trump’s allies in the Senate are doing everything they can to gut Medicaid, rip away health care from millions of families and hand out massive tax breaks to billionaires and corporate donors. It’s cynical and cruel — and unless we fight back, it’s going to get worse. I’m doing everything I can in the Senate to stop the damage. name: Christina Gagnier
subject: There is too much at stake to sit on the sidelines.
body:
|
#
I’ll be honest, Peter: I never thought that I would be in this position.

I have spent my career helping people and uplifting our communities in the Inland Empire and Orange County – from starting my own small business and helping others start and sustain theirs, to fighting for kids on the school board, and later, through my national organization, Our Schools USA.

**But, when I saw Young Kim fail us by putting the MAGA agenda ahead of our communities, I knew I had to act. There is too much at stake to sit on the sidelines.**

The good news is that Young Kim has lost a congressional election before. In fact, it was in a Trump midterm election just like this one. We have a real opportunity to fire Young Kim – the last Republican representing OC in Congress – and replace her with an actual community leader.

Hey Blue Amp family!
**If you missed today 's **_**Amped Up**_**, buckle up, because Cliff came out swinging.**
_**Here 's the lightning rundown:**_
1. **Cliff 's Opening Rant: "Do It."**
**Cliff kicked off with a fiery call to arms:[Democrats need to gerrymander aggressively](https://substack.com/redirect/85cc8949-aee0-4819-b4fb-da5b5903220b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in every state where we hold a trifecta.** Not because we love gerrymandering, but because Republicans are weaponizing it to shred democracy. [We must grab hold of every political advantage](https://substack.com/redirect/9c08e48b-a987-4cd9-8c93-2a9626085ca2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because they sure will without a second thought. His message was simple: "_Stop bringing a Nerf hammer to a sledgehammer fight. Don 't Look Backward, Fight forward"_
2. **Trump 's Presidential Fitness Test Hypocrisy**
Trump is relaunching the presidential fitness test--ironic, given his own "Big Mac" lifestyle--while simultaneously slashing food stamps, school lunches, and Medicaid. David brought up the topic which brought David and Cliff much laughter. David ripped the cruelty and stupidity of starving kids in school by cutting SNAP funding, while preaching fitness.
3. **ICE Brutality in Florida**
**We covered the horrifying story of 18-year-old American citizen Kenny Lainez, tackled and choked by ICE agents** while telling them he had rights. Their response to this U.S. Citizen: "You have no rights." Cliff called it exactly what it is: _a police state in action._ The cruelty is the point--the accountability's nonexistent.
4. **Exclusive: Billionaire Steven Cloobeck for Governor of California**
Our main guest, billionaire and philanthropist **Steven Cloobeck** , joined us for a wide-ranging interview. He didn't hold back--and neither did we, not with our crazy world of [Trumps, Putins](https://substack.com/redirect/c6b55de4-a660-44ae-815a-9f4eaa3a7163?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Hamas. Bibi, etc...
**Some interesting moments**
* Cloobeck criticized Kamala Harris for being "disconnected" and applauded her decision not to run for governor. Cliff reminded him that she only had 90 days to run a presidential campaign. They both wondered what he thought about the outsized influence of billionaires, with Cliff pointing out [the danger to our democracy posed by tech-bro fascists like Elon Musk & Peter Thiel](https://substack.com/redirect/18d2c8b6-918d-4816-a6c0-373bee153594?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* He laid out plans for **homelessness solutions using empty office buildings** , a "California Department of Performance and Results," and cutting red tape to get businesses moving. David and Cliff asked how this would be done logistically, how many empty office buildings there were and more.
* He said he's ready to **fight California 's fights like a businessman, not a bureaucrat**--and isn't afraid to throw a punch at political opponents or even ex-girlfriends who cross him. David questioned why he seemed to be in constant lawsuits, including this ex-girlfriend who was a an "OnlyFans" model and the former Mayor of Los Angeles, Antonio Villaraigosa. David even asked if it was fair that some called him the "Democratic [Donald Trump."](https://substack.com/redirect/16c871e4-6534-4a13-8ce6-bf4701826e68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Cliff and David were not cantankerous, but they were no pushovers. They were fair, but they steered Cloobeck back to unanswered questions--following up, [oh denizens of corporate media who've forgotten what the phrase means](https://substack.com/redirect/9bd4b704-fbf6-497e-982a-c0abd388a5c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and it got a bit testy once or twice. And if you know Cliff and David, you know there was as much humor as one can fit in an interview with a billionaire, California candidate for governor.
**Maybe not 1000, but this picture must be worth at least 845 words:**

name: Aruna Miller
subject: Our fortunes are tied together
body:
[ https://act.wesmoore.com/go/9?t=1001&akid=393%2E1086043%2ELSbmPa ]Wes Moore for Governor[ https://act.wesmoore.com/go/9?t=1002&akid=393%2E1086043%2ELSbmPa ]Wes Moore for Governor

Peter, it’s Aruna Miller, Lt. Governor of Maryland.

Can I tell you what it’s like to work with Wes Moore? Every single day, he
shows up with purpose and leads with compassion.

That kind of leadership has an impact — and I know it personally.

I spent much of my life trying to fit into spaces that didn’t have me in
mind. I was an immigrant growing up in a new country, a female engineer in
a male-dominated field, and an Indian-American legislator in a legislature
that didn’t look like me.

Over the years, I had to learn to have the courage to be my authentic self
in every space. That’s happened to too many of our communities throughout
our history.

Too many people have been left behind — from Black and brown communities
seeking their rights, to women seeking bodily autonomy, to people wanting
to love who they love and be who they are, to families struggling to get
benefits and get by in difficult economic circumstances.

Governor Moore and I see you. That’s why every day, we fight to address
the inequities of the past and build a Maryland where we Leave No One
Behind.

Our fortunes are tied together. We can’t do this alone. Achieving this
vision will take the strength of the movement that has been on our side
since day one. It will take serious effort to organize, mobilize, and
scale our movement, but it’s possible together.

end-of-month deadline tonight? Your donation will power our work and help
move Maryland forward.

Thank you,

Aruna Miller

If we fall short tonight, we risk falling behind in a race we cannot afford to lose. | | | | One of the best ways that you can support our movement is by donating $13 to “Team 13”. I’m sure your inbox is crowded, but there’s something I need to say, and I hope you’ll hear me out. If you care about our climate and our democracy, then you have to care about who gets elected down the ballot. Because the truth is, so many of the most urgent climate decisions — whether to greenlight a pipeline, invest in clean energy, or protect public land (_or hand it over to Big Oil_) — don’t get made in Washington. They get made in city councils. County commissions. State legislatures. These local and state-level leaders are our first line of defense, and they’re also the next generation of national leadership. If we don’t invest early and often in down-ballot races, you can bet that the other side will. # THE MENDOZA BRIEF
# The Latest News from Team Mendoza
# July 31, 2025
---
| The Mendoza Brief is a way for our campaign to share the latest news, opportunities, and updates from the campaign trail. 🏜️

---
|
---
|
# July Endorsement Roundup
---
| July proved to be an exciting month, with multiple endorsements from key community leaders and organizations putting their support behind Jo. This month, Jo was proud to receive the endorsements from **former** **Arizona Congressman Ron Barber** ,**EMILYs List** ,**and Latino Victory Fund**!
The endorsements come as Jo’s campaign has seen widespread support from local and national organizations, community leaders, and grassroots donors. Raising **over $1.3 million** since launching in February, Jo has emerged as the clear frontrunner to take on vulnerable Juan Ciscomani next year.
To see the full list of endorsements, click or tap below!
---
| [Check out the full list of endorsements here!](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=aa15f8ea74&e=fea3203902)
---
|
---
|
# What issues are most important to you?
---
| Jo wants to hear from you!
One of the most important priorities for JoAnna is to actually hear from the people about the issues that matter the most to them. Let us know what you care about by filling out the survey below.
---
| [Let us know what’s important to you!](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=3765e856b5&e=fea3203902)
---
|
---
|
# A Brief History on the Hell Cats
---
| The [Lady Hell Cats](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=9889fe5d34&e=fea3203902) were trailblazing women who became the first to enlist in the U.S. Marine Corps during World War I. Officially called “Marinettes,” they embraced the nickname “Hell Cats” to reflect their grit and determination in a male-dominated military. These women took on clerical and administrative roles, freeing men to fight overseas. Despite facing deep skepticism, they proved their value and paved the way for future generations of women in uniform. Their courage and service laid the foundation for Marines like Jo, who continue the fight for equality and representation in service to our country.
Jo is honored to team up with three other women veterans - **Maura Sullivan, Rebecca Bennett, and Cait Conley** \- who are running for Congress across the country to bring the spirit of servant leadership to DC.
---
[|
---](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=2f8da1c1cb&e=fea3203902)
|
---
|
# Coffee with Jo!
---
| Earlier this month, Jo held a Cafecito in Tucson where constituents were able to meet and tell her about the issues they are most concerned about - with coffee and conchas!
Stay tuned for when Jo will be in a neighborhood near you!
---
|
---
|
# Interested in serving on an advisory committee? Let us know!
---
| AZ-06 is full of people with lived experiences in so many different aspects of daily life - whether it be water, health care, technology, senior issues, youth, and more. Part of Jo’s community approach to representing AZ-06 will be establishing advisory committees on different topics. These advisory committees will be able to give key insights into the important issues facing AZ-06 and the nation at large.
If you live in AZ-06 and are interested in serving on an advisory committee, let us know!

# Jo in the News
---
| [**Thursday, July 10 | Punchbowl News** : JoAnna Mendoza, a Democrat seeking to unseat Rep. Juan Ciscomani (R-Ariz.), raised $436,000 in the second quarter.](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=6a86b82458&e=fea3203902)

If you live in AZ-06, please take a moment to sign Jo’s nomination petition online and follow Jo on social media using the buttons below.

body:
| Peter,

Before I head into a meeting with my campaign team, I wanted to take a quick moment to write to you.

This past month has been one of the most energizing of the campaign so far. I spent time out on the fairgrounds across our district. And let me tell you, Iowans are showing up.

People stopped by not just to say hello, but to talk about their communities, their schools, their kids, their hopes for the future. And the message is clear: Iowans are ready for something different. They’re ready for leadership that listens. Our representatives shouldn't answer to party elites or corporate donors, but to the people who make this state what it is.

I left each fair a little sunburned, but also deeply hopeful. People talk about a summer slump, but I’m seeing the exact opposite. This team is fired up. We're growing, and we’re laying the groundwork to flip this seat in 2026.

But if we want to keep the momentum going through August, we can’t slow down now. Every goal we hit gets us one step closer to reaching more voters, building more support, and taking back this district.

If you’ve been thinking about chipping in, now’s the time. body:
Trump knows he’s deeply unpopular, and so he’s trying to rig the maps to avoid a shellacking in the 2026 midterms.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2608%2E4032634%2EQCdkD0)
---
Texas Republicans just released their proposed redistricting map, which sets them up to steal five congressional seats in the midterm elections. Let’s back up for a second to talk about what’s going on here. Redistricting typically happens every 10 years after new census data is released. But this month, Trump demanded that Texas “do a very simple redraw” to gerrymander districts so Republicans can “pick up five seats.” Governor Greg Abbott was more than happy to follow Trump’s orders. While much of the state was recovering from deadly flooding, Texas Republicans decided now would be a good time to make their districts even _more_ gerrymandered than they already were. **We need to call this what it is: Republicans are trying to rig Congressional maps so that they can hold on to power in the 2026 midterms and beyond. What happens next in Texas could be the difference between Democrats taking back the House in 2026 and checking Trump’s power — or Republicans feeling free to gerrymander every state they control to try to keep their stranglehold on power.** **Put simply: This is a whole lot bigger than Texas.** [**Will you split a donation with Texas Democrats and our campaign to continue standing up to the far-right and power the fight on the ground to stop this attack on our democracy?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3070?t=8&akid=2608%2E4032634%2EQCdkD0)

You might be asking why Trump ordered the Texas legislature to force through a gerrymandered map. Maybe you’re also wondering why Texas Republicans are bending over backwards to do his bidding. The President of the United States ordered Texas to gerrymander the state even further and eliminate more Democratic held congressional districts. Hi there,
growing up, my parents taught me that everyone deserves a fair shot in
life.

As special education teachers they took me to work with them and I got to
see first hand how hard they fought for their students to be treated
fairly. From long nights writing IEPs to preparing classes on the weekend,
they worked hard to ensure all kids could have access to a quality
education.

Through their work my parents instilled in me the importance of service.
They taught me we all do better when we all do better. And that if you see
a wrong, it’s your job to try to make it right.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/239?c0=jmb-em-q32025.A5XsW4&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20250731_PM1_V1_S1&t=1009&akid=571%2E181023%2EcW0Lm8 ]Jocelyn and her family

I’ve carried those lessons with me every step of my life — from my time
working in civil rights, to leading Wayne State Law School, to serving as
Secretary of State. I’ve never given up the fight to ensure everyone has a
fair chance to thrive.

I’m running for Governor of Michigan to continue that work and make sure
that every Michigan family has that fair shot.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/854?c0=jmb-em-q32025.OcO0Lx&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20250731_PM1_V1_S1&t=1010&akid=571%2E181023%2EcW0Lm8 ]If you’re with me, can you pitch in a donation to my campaign right
now, ahead of our upcoming end-of-month fundraising deadline? Anything you
can give makes a difference.

I’ve investigated radical extremist groups, taught civil rights and voting
rights law, and I ran for Secretary of State to make sure our government
is efficient and transparent, that every voice is heard, and that every
legitimate vote is counted.

Some people didn’t like that very much — but I’ve never backed down from a
tough fight. I’ve spent my life standing up to powerful interests, and
I’ll keep standing up to any bullies or billionaires who try to deceive
us, divide us, take away our rights, or deprive us of our opportunities.

Now, I’m fighting to make Michigan the best place to be a kid, raise a
kid, stay, and call home. To do that, we need transparent leadership, safe
schools and neighborhoods, and good education and childcare. Every
Michigander should be able to pay their bills, put food on the table, and
take care of their families.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/854?c0=jmb-em-q32025.OcO0Lx&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20250731_PM1_V1_S1&t=1011&akid=571%2E181023%2EcW0Lm8 ]That’s what I’m ready to fight for as Michigan’s next Governor. Will

They’ve already passed devastating budget cuts, slashing Medicaid, school funding and food assistance. And they’re just getting started... But it will give us the power to block the next wave of cruelty, hold hearings, shine a light on corruption and finally go on offense again. I represent the only toss-up seat in New York and one of the most competitive in the country. If we lose it, we are all but guaranteed to lose our shot at taking back the House. | Hi Peter,

Thanks to your dedication, we’ve proven that **people-powered, grassroots organizing works** — and we’re just getting started. 👏 Because of your efforts, we’ve advanced to the **Special General Election on September 23rd** , where we’re on the path to making history by electing **Adelita as the first Latina woman to represent Arizona in Congress**! 🌵✨
